jobs.title: Head Product Management Funds

titleByLocale.fr: Fonds de gestion des produits principaux

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Product Management Funds

London, Zurich |  Hybrid 60-40% | Reference 8243

Introduction
SIX is a leading provider of financial information, data services and related solutions for the financial services industry. We are seeking an experienced product leader to head the Funds Product Management function within SIX Financial Information. Reporting directly to the Head Product & Commercial Strategy, you will lead a team of Senior Product Managers and subject matter experts, shaping the strategic direction of our Funds proposition, driving commercial growth, and ensuring our offerings remain highly relevant, differentiated and aligned with evolving client and market needs.

What You Will Do

•    Define and execute the Funds product, content and commercial strategy, roadmap and proposition, ensuring alignment with business objectives, client demand and regulatory developments.
•    Drive revenue growth by strengthening market positioning, enhancing proposition clarity, supporting Sales teams and increasing client engagement across target markets.
•    Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from market opportunity identification and business case development through to product launch, performance management and retirement.
•    Simplify and optimise the Funds product portfolio by supporting end-of-life decisions for legacy services and integrating valuable capabilities into the strategic Funds offering.
•    Establish and deliver strategic objectives for content sourcing, data quality, service levels and automation, while reducing dependency on third-party providers through increased direct sourcing.
•    Partner closely with Data Operations, Technology, Business and IT Architecture teams to optimise operating models, improve organisational effectiveness and lead a high-performing team of Senior Product Managers and SMEs.

What You Will Bring

•    Significant experience in product management, product strategy or commercial product leadership within financial information, funds, asset management, wealth management or related data services.
•    Strong understanding of the Funds ecosystem, including market structure, client workflows, data sourcing, quality management, service delivery and regulatory requirements.
•    Proven ability to translate market opportunities into compelling product propositions, investment cases, commercial priorities and measurable business outcomes.
•    Experience leading expert product teams and influencing senior stakeholders across product, operations, technology, sales and executive leadership functions.
•    Excellent communication, commercial judgement and strategic decision-making skills, with the ability to drive focus, scalability and long-term client value.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Head Business Architecture
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Business Architecture

London, Zurich |  Hybrid 60-40% | Reference 8233

Introduction
As Head of Business Architecture at SIX Financial Information, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic evolution of our financial data platforms. Working closely with senior business leaders, IT Architecture, and technology teams, you will translate business strategy into tangible transformation initiatives that drive growth, innovation, and operational excellence. Reporting into and working with Head Product & Commercial Strategy, you will lead a team of Business Architects, champion capability-driven planning, and help modernise the delivery of critical financial information products across our core content pillars, including Index, Funds, Fixed Income, Reference Data, and Market Data. Acting as a trusted strategic advisor, you will partner closely with IT Architecture and bridge the gap between business and technology, ensuring that platform investments align with long-term business objectives and customer needs.

What You Will Do

•    Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Business Architects Specialists, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
•    Translate business strategy into actionable business architecture artefacts, including value streams, process maps, business operating models and a strategic narrative and accompanying roadmaps.
•    In close partnership with Head of IT Architecture, contribute to the development and evolution of business capability models and joint strategic roadmaps that bridge strategy and execution
•    Partner closely with IT Architecture and business leaders to identify and drive transformation opportunities that enhance data platforms and delivery capabilities.
•    Conduct assessments of existing platforms, processes, and operating models, including functional SWOT analyses and supporting build-versus-buy evaluations, to support strategic decision-making.
•    Develop compelling business cases and executive-level recommendations that support investment decisions and enterprise transformation initiatives.
•    Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external vendors to evaluate emerging technologies, integrate third-party solutions, and optimise workflows across the organisation.

What You Will Bring

•    Extensive experience within the financial information industry, with deep expertise in market data, reference data, corporate actions, and financial data platforms.
•    Proven success in developing and applying structured frameworks and models, including value stream mapping, business operating models, and strategic planning methodologies.
•    Understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, data integration approaches (APIs, SFTP), and modern platform transformation programmes.
•    Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to engage and challenge senior executives, technology leaders, and cross-functional teams.
•    Outstanding analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, with a track record of translating complex business challenges into practical solutions and clear recommendations.
•    A collaborative leadership style, with a proven track record of partnering with IT Architecture and Technology functions, excellent communication and presentation skills, and the ability to inspire teams while driving organisational change and business outcomes.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a dare forma al futuro della finanza con noi.

Responsabile Architettura aziendale

Londra, Zurigo | Ibrido 60-40% | Riferimento 8233

Introduzione
In qualità di responsabile dell'architettura aziendale presso SIX Financial Information, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel definire l'evoluzione strategica delle nostre piattaforme di dati finanziari. Lavorando a stretto contatto con dirigenti aziendali senior, architettura IT e team tecnologici, tradurrai la strategia aziendale in iniziative di trasformazione tangibili che guidano la crescita, l'innovazione e l'eccellenza operativa. Riportando e collaborando con Head Product & Commercial Strategy, guiderai un team di Business Architect, sosterrai la pianificazione basata sulle capacità e contribuirai a modernizzare la fornitura di prodotti di informazioni finanziarie critiche attraverso i nostri pilastri di contenuti principali, tra cui Indici, Fondi, Reddito fisso, Dati di riferimento e Dati di mercato. Agendo come consulente strategico di fiducia, collaborerai a stretto contatto con l'architettura IT e colmerai il divario tra business e tecnologia, assicurando che gli investimenti sulla piattaforma siano in linea con gli obiettivi aziendali a lungo termine e le esigenze dei clienti.

Cosa farai

• Guidare, guidare e sviluppare un team ad alte prestazioni di specialisti di architetti aziendali, promuovendo una cultura di collaborazione, innovazione e miglioramento continuo.
• Tradurre la strategia aziendale in artefatti fruibili dell'architettura aziendale, inclusi flussi di valore, mappe di processi, modelli operativi aziendali e una narrazione strategica e roadmap di accompagnamento.
• In stretta collaborazione con il responsabile dell'architettura IT, contribuire allo sviluppo e all'evoluzione dei modelli di capacità aziendali e delle roadmap strategiche congiunte che collegano strategia ed esecuzione
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con l'architettura IT e i leader aziendali per identificare e promuovere opportunità di trasformazione che migliorino le piattaforme dati e le capacità di distribuzione.
• Condurre valutazioni di piattaforme, processi e modelli operativi esistenti, comprese analisi SWOT funzionali e supportare valutazioni build-versus-buy, per supportare il processo decisionale strategico.
• Sviluppare casi aziendali convincenti e raccomandazioni a livello esecutivo che supportino le decisioni di investimento e le iniziative di trasformazione aziendale.
• Collaborare con le parti interessate interne e i fornitori esterni per valutare le tecnologie emergenti, integrare soluzioni di terze parti e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro all'interno dell'organizzazione.

Cosa porterai

• Vasta esperienza nel settore dell'informazione finanziaria, con una profonda conoscenza dei dati di mercato, dei dati di riferimento, delle azioni societarie e delle piattaforme di dati finanziari.
• Comprovato successo nello sviluppo e nell'applicazione di strutture e modelli strutturati, tra cui la mappatura del flusso di valore, modelli operativi aziendali e metodologie di pianificazione strategica.
• Comprensione del panorama tecnologico aziendale, degli approcci di integrazione dei dati (API, SFTP) e dei moderni programmi di trasformazione della piattaforma.
• Eccezionali capacità di gestione e influenza degli stakeholder, con la capacità di coinvolgere e sfidare dirigenti senior, leader tecnologici e team interfunzionali.
• Eccezionali capacità analitiche e di pensiero strategico, con un track record nel tradurre sfide aziendali complesse in soluzioni pratiche e raccomandazioni chiare.
• Uno stile di leadership collaborativo, con una comprovata esperienza di collaborazione con le funzioni di architettura e tecnologia IT, eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e presentazione e la capacità di ispirare i team guidando al tempo stesso il cambiamento organizzativo e i risultati aziendali.

In caso di domande, consulta la nostra pagina delle domande frequenti o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407.

Per questo posto accettiamo solo candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, cerchiamo di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokaler Verwurzelung und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft des Finanzwesens.

Leiter Geschäftsarchitektur

London, Zürich | Hybrid 60-40 % | Referenz 8233

Einführung
Als Head of Business Architecture bei SIX Financial Information spielen Sie eine entscheidende Rolle bei der Gestaltung der strategischen Weiterentwicklung unserer Finanzdatenplattformen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Unternehmensleitern, IT-Architektur- und Technologieteams setzen Sie die Geschäftsstrategie in konkrete Transformationsinitiativen um, die Wachstum, Innovation und operative Exzellenz vorantreiben. Sie berichten an den Head Product & Commercial Strategy und arbeiten mit ihm zusammen. Sie leiten ein Team von Business Architects, setzen sich für eine fähigkeitsorientierte Planung ein und helfen bei der Modernisierung der Bereitstellung wichtiger Finanzinformationsprodukte über unsere Kerninhaltssäulen hinweg, einschließlich Index, Fonds, festverzinsliche Wertpapiere, Referenzdaten und Marktdaten. Als vertrauenswürdiger strategischer Berater arbeiten Sie eng mit der IT-Architektur zusammen und schließen die Lücke zwischen Geschäft und Technologie. So stellen Sie sicher, dass Plattforminvestitionen mit langfristigen Geschäftszielen und Kundenbedürfnissen im Einklang stehen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Führen, betreuen und entwickeln Sie ein leistungsstarkes Team von Business Architects-Spezialisten und fördern Sie eine Kultur der Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und kontinuierlichen Verbesserung.
• Übersetzen Sie die Geschäftsstrategie in umsetzbare Geschäftsarchitekturartefakte, einschließlich Wertströme, Prozesskarten, Geschäftsbetriebsmodelle sowie eine strategische Erzählung und begleitende Roadmaps.
• Tragen Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Leiter der IT-Architektur zur Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Geschäftsfähigkeitsmodellen und gemeinsamen strategischen Roadmaps bei, die Strategie und Umsetzung verbinden
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit IT-Architektur- und Unternehmensleitern zusammen, um Transformationsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und voranzutreiben, die Datenplattformen und Bereitstellungsmöglichkeiten verbessern.
• Führen Sie Bewertungen bestehender Plattformen, Prozesse und Betriebsmodelle durch, einschließlich funktionaler SWOT-Analysen und unterstützender Build-versus-Buy-Bewertungen, um die strategische Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.
• Entwickeln Sie überzeugende Business Cases und Empfehlungen auf Führungsebene, die Investitionsentscheidungen und Unternehmenstransformationsinitiativen unterstützen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit internen Stakeholdern und externen Anbietern zusammen, um neue Technologien zu bewerten, Lösungen von Drittanbietern zu integrieren und Arbeitsabläufe im gesamten Unternehmen zu optimieren.

Was Sie mitbringen werden

• Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Finanzinformationsbranche mit fundiertem Fachwissen in Marktdaten, Referenzdaten, Kapitalmaßnahmen und Finanzdatenplattformen.
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Anwendung strukturierter Frameworks und Modelle, einschließlich der Abbildung von Wertströmen, Geschäftsmodellen und strategischen Planungsmethoden.
• Verständnis für Unternehmenstechnologielandschaften, Datenintegrationsansätze (APIs, SFTP) und moderne Plattformtransformationsprogramme.
• Außergewöhnliche Stakeholder-Management- und Einflussfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Führungskräfte, Technologieführer und funktionsübergreifende Teams einzubeziehen und herauszufordern.
• Hervorragende analytische und strategische Denkfähigkeiten mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung komplexer geschäftlicher Herausforderungen in praktische Lösungen und klare Empfehlungen.
• Ein kollaborativer Führungsstil mit nachweislicher Erfolgsbilanz in der Zusammenarbeit mit IT-Architektur- und Technologiefunktionen, hervorragenden Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und der Fähigkeit, Teams zu inspirieren und gleichzeitig organisatorische Veränderungen und Geschäftsergebnisse voranzutreiben.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, schauen Sie sich unsere FAQ-Seite an oder rufen Sie Anthony Mills unter +44 207 550 5407 an.

Für diese Stelle nehmen wir ausschließlich Direktbewerbungen entgegen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX pilote la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir de la finance avec nous.

Responsable de l'architecture d'entreprise

Londres, Zurich | Hybride 60-40% | Référence 8233

Introduction
En tant que responsable de l'architecture commerciale chez SIX Financial Information, vous jouerez un rôle central dans l'élaboration de l'évolution stratégique de nos plateformes de données financières. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les hauts dirigeants de l'entreprise, les équipes d'architecture informatique et de technologie, vous traduirez la stratégie commerciale en initiatives de transformation tangibles qui stimulent la croissance, l'innovation et l'excellence opérationnelle. Relevant du responsable des produits et de la stratégie commerciale et travaillant avec lui, vous dirigerez une équipe d'architectes commerciaux, défendrez la planification axée sur les capacités et contribuerez à moderniser la fourniture de produits d'information financière critiques sur nos principaux piliers de contenu, notamment les indices, les fonds, les titres à revenu fixe, les données de référence et les données de marché. En tant que conseiller stratégique de confiance, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec l'architecture informatique et comblerez le fossé entre l'entreprise et la technologie, en veillant à ce que les investissements dans la plate-forme correspondent aux objectifs commerciaux à long terme et aux besoins des clients.

Ce que vous ferez

• Diriger, encadrer et développer une équipe hautement performante de spécialistes en architecture d'affaires, favorisant une culture de collaboration, d'innovation et d'amélioration continue.
• Traduire la stratégie commerciale en artefacts d'architecture commerciale exploitables, y compris les flux de valeur, les cartes de processus, les modèles opérationnels commerciaux, ainsi qu'un récit stratégique et les feuilles de route qui l'accompagnent.
• En étroite collaboration avec le responsable de l'architecture informatique, contribuer au développement et à l'évolution des modèles de capacités commerciales et des feuilles de route stratégiques communes qui relient la stratégie et l'exécution.
• Collaborer étroitement avec l'architecture informatique et les dirigeants d'entreprise pour identifier et piloter les opportunités de transformation qui améliorent les plateformes de données et les capacités de livraison.
• Mener des évaluations des plates-formes, des processus et des modèles opérationnels existants, y compris des analyses SWOT fonctionnelles et des évaluations de construction par rapport à l'achat, pour soutenir la prise de décision stratégique.
• Élaborer des analyses de rentabilisation convaincantes et des recommandations au niveau de la direction qui soutiennent les décisions d'investissement et les initiatives de transformation de l'entreprise.
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes internes et les fournisseurs externes pour évaluer les technologies émergentes, intégrer des solutions tierces et optimiser les flux de travail dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Ce que vous apporterez

• Vaste expérience dans le secteur de l'information financière, avec une expertise approfondie des données de marché, des données de référence, des opérations sur titres et des plateformes de données financières.
• Succès avéré dans le développement et l'application de cadres et de modèles structurés, y compris la cartographie de la chaîne de valeur, les modèles opérationnels commerciaux et les méthodologies de planification stratégique.
• Compréhension des paysages technologiques d'entreprise, des approches d'intégration de données (API, SFTP) et des programmes de transformation de plateforme modernes.
• Compétences exceptionnelles en matière de gestion des parties prenantes et d'influence, avec la capacité d'impliquer et de défier les cadres supérieurs, les leaders technologiques et les équipes interfonctionnelles.
• Capacités exceptionnelles de réflexion analytique et stratégique, avec une expérience dans la traduction de défis commerciaux complexes en solutions pratiques et en recommandations claires.
• Un style de leadership collaboratif, avec une expérience avérée en matière de partenariat avec des fonctions d'architecture et de technologie informatiques, d'excellentes compétences en communication et en présentation, et la capacité d'inspirer les équipes tout en pilotant le changement organisationnel et les résultats commerciaux.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Anthony Mills au +44 207 550 5407.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des candidatures indépendamment de toute expérience personnelle.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer (80-100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8241

Do you want to design, build, and operate reliable, scalable systems powering financial index services? Are you passionate about hands-on engineering and solving complex technical challenges in a distributed environment?

Our Index team is based in Zurich and India and develops core platforms that enable the creation, calculation, and distribution of financial indices. We work at the intersection of data, engineering, and financial markets, ensuring stable and high-quality services for internal and external stakeholders.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a senior individual contributor within this distributed setup, working closely with engineers in Zurich and India. You will combine deep hands-on engineering expertise with end-to-end technical ownership, shaping robust solutions from design through production. You will collaborate closely with product managers, domain experts, SRE teams, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and effective systems.

What You Will Do

• Design, build, and maintain backend services using Java (Spring Boot) and Python for index calculation and data processing platforms

• Own the end-to-end delivery of features, ensuring they are delivered on time and meet quality expectations

• Take technical ownership of complex components and features, from solution design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support

• Collaborate with SRE teams to ensure systems are reliable and production-ready, contributing to improvements where needed

• Drive architecture and engineering decisions to improve scalability, performance, and maintainability

What You Bring

• Deep hands-on software engineering expertise with Java (Spring Boot) and Python, including building, testing, deploying, and supporting production services

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex technical problems and make sound architecture and engineering decisions in production environments

• Strong knowledge of backend and distributed system design, including scalability, resilience, performance, observability, and maintainable integration patterns

• Experience using modern engineering tooling and AI-assisted development to improve productivity and code quality

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience in building and operating production systems

• Fluent English communication skills; German is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: AI Engineer - Test Automation & Guardrails
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros y pertenece a SIX, el tercer grupo bursátil más grande de Europa.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

AI Engineer - Test Automation & Guardrails

Warsaw, Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Referencia  8247

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. We're building a new team at the center of this shift, responsible for shaping how AI-driven software engineering works across the company. As part of this team, you will build the guardrails that make agentic development trustworthy at scale: the test automation, coverage enforcement, and independent review layers that let AI agents write and ship code without compromising quality.

What You Will Do

• build test automation as a platform capability, not a project. Agent-driven test generation and maintenance, coverage enforcement on changed lines, flaky-test detection and self-healing, mutation testing, and test-suite health (redundancy, gaps, execution time) across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers.

• build and operate the AI agent harness. The sandboxed execution environment, tool/permission scoping, and CI/CD integration that lets agents propose, test, and merge code, instrumented with decision logs and action provenance so every agentic change is traceable and reproducible.

• own the independent review layer for AI-generated code and tests: correctness, coverage, and quality gates in CI/CD that verify what an agent produces using tooling the agent doesn't control, so speed never comes at the cost of test quality or code health.

• define and evolve the test strategy for an AI-driven SDLC. What gets tested where, how test data is generated and managed, and how test quality is measured (not just pass/fail, but whether the tests catch regressions).

• treat test automation and guardrails as a product, not a gate. Instrument for adoption, false-positive rate, and developer trust, keeping the safe, well-tested path the fastest path.

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software engineering with deep, hands-on expertise in test automation. Ideally a software/platform engineer in test, with a track record of building tooling or developer infrastructure that other engineering teams adopted, not just writing test suites.

• hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures. Agent orchestration, tool-use/sandboxing, and harness design, not just conceptual awareness of "AI in the SDLC."

• deep knowledge of test methodology and code quality: test pyramids, coverage strategy, mutation testing, flaky-test remediation, and what makes a test suite trustworthy versus just green.

• platform-product mindset. You build reusable capabilities and pave roads for other engineers, and you measure and strive for adoption and impact across SIX's business units.

• working knowledge of governance and controls in a regulated or high-assurance setting. Financial market infrastructure experience is a plus, but adjacent regulated-industry background is a plus. A pragmatic, collaborative bias toward quality and automation.

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko   +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

Agent-driven test generation and maintenance, coverage enforcement on changed lines, flaky-test detection and self-healing, mutation testing, and test-suite health (redundancy, gaps, execution time) across unit, integration, and end-to-end layers.

• build and operate the AI agent harness. The sandboxed execution environment, tool/permission scoping, and CI/CD integration that lets agents propose, test, and merge code, instrumented with decision logs and action provenance so every agentic change is traceable and reproducible.

• own the independent review layer for AI-generated code and tests: correctness, coverage, and quality gates in CI/CD that verify what an agent produces using tooling the agent doesn't control, so speed never comes at the cost of test quality or code health.

• define and evolve the test strategy for an AI-driven SDLC. What gets tested where, how test data is generated and managed, and how test quality is measured (not just pass/fail, but whether the tests catch regressions).

• treat test automation and guardrails as a product, not a gate. Instrument for adoption, false-positive rate, and developer trust, keeping the safe, well-tested path the fastest path.

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software engineering with deep, hands-on expertise in test automation. Ideally a software/platform engineer in test, with a track record of building tooling or developer infrastructure that other engineering teams adopted, not just writing test suites.

• hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures. Agent orchestration, tool-use/sandboxing, and harness design, not just conceptual awareness of "AI in the SDLC."

• deep knowledge of test methodology and code quality: test pyramids, coverage strategy, mutation testing, flaky-test remediation, and what makes a test suite trustworthy versus just green.

• platform-product mindset. You build reusable capabilities and pave roads for other engineers, and you measure and strive for adoption and impact across SIX's business units.

• working knowledge of governance and controls in a regulated or high-assurance setting. Financial market infrastructure experience is a plus, but adjacent regulated-industry background is a plus. A pragmatic, collaborative bias toward quality and automation.

Si tienes alguna duda, consulta nuestra página de preguntas frecuentes (FAQ) o contacta con Yuliya Stoyko +34 917095993 .

Para esta vacante sólo aceptamos solicitudes directas.

La diversidad es importante para nosotros. Por lo tanto, estamos deseando recibir solicitudes independientemente de cualquier contexto personal.

Ce que vous ferez
• Fournir un soutien de premier niveau (surveillance, triage, déploiement de logiciels, etc.)
• Fournir un support de 2ème niveau (dépannage de l'application)
• Mettre en œuvre l'automatisation pour des tâches et des processus spécifiques
• Interagir avec l'application informatique et les équipes d'affaires Ce que vous apportez
• Baccalauréat ou certificat d'enseignement supérieur en technologie de l'information ou similaire
• Connaissance avancée de l'exploitation (linux et fenêtres)
• Gestion des applications conteneurisées (OCP/K8S)
• Les pratiques DevOps et la compréhension des outils seront précieuses
• L'expérience d'automatisation (Ansible, IC/CD, etc.) sera également prise en considération de manière positive.
• Volonté de travailler selon un horaire tournant, y compris les quarts du matin à l'après-midi
• Compétences efficaces en communication orale et écrite en anglais et en espagnol Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 . Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes. La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Business Data Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Data Architect

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 8194

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on our business data model, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with Product Teams, SMEs and Operations as key stakeholders.

We are looking for a Data Architect with UML business data model experience to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group for a hands on role updating and maintaining our business data model. This encompasses the design of conceptual data models and deep analysis of the data which underpins it. The team also creates physical schemas, so experience or an interest in creating JSON schemas from conceptual models is a plus!

``

What You Will Do

• work with stakeholders across the business to review, update and design the conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.

• develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.

• partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust UML data models that form the basis of BFI products.

• support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

• work closely with our Quality Management stakeholders, to drive adoption of the data model and data completeness.

What You Bring

• financial data knowledge: Strong understanding of the financial data domain. For example, securities reference data, corporate actions, tax/regulatory classifications or market data

• technical skills: Programming language experience in SQL, Phython and Vbscript, VBA . Demonstrated proficiency in UML business data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar, with experience in forward engineering and database or data warehouse design highly desirable.

• strong understanding of data governance best practices such as the role of data owners, stewards and custodians and of conceptual and physical data models. Experience with data catalogs is desirable, but not mandatory.

• collaborative and detail oriented approach to analytical and modelling tasks. The team collaborate with many stakeholders and the outputs of these discussions must be clearly held in the Business Data Model.

• fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Architetto di dati aziendali

Varsavia | lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8194

La divisione Informazioni Finanziarie all'interno del Gruppo SIX è un fornitore globale di dati finanziari e analisi per il settore dei servizi finanziari globali. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno della divisione Business-led Product Development e si concentra sul nostro modello di dati aziendali, garantendo che i nostri prodotti finanziari soddisfano le esigenze del cliente, commerciale e regolamentare. Il ruolo collabora a stretto contatto con i team di prodotti, le PMI e le operazioni come principali stakeholder.

Siamo alla ricerca di un Data Architect con l'esperienza del modello di dati aziendali UML per lavorare all'interno del gruppo Financial Information Product Delivery per una mano sull'aggiornamento del ruolo e il mantenimento del nostro modello di dati aziendali. Ciò comprende la progettazione di modelli di dati concettuali e l'analisi profonda dei dati che lo sostengono. Il team crea anche schemi fisici, quindi l'esperienza o l'interesse a creare schemi JSON da modelli concettuali è un plus!

``

Cosa farai

• lavorare con gli stakeholder di tutto il business per rivedere, aggiornare e progettare i modelli di dati concettuali per le informazioni finanziarie, definendo le definizioni di classe, gli standard e l'associazione semantica.

• sviluppare e mantenere la progettazione, design convenzioni, dizionari, lineage e metadati standard, collaborando con i team di qualità dei dati per garantire le regole di validazione dei modelli.

• partner con gli stakeholder di tutto il business per tradurre concetti e requisiti di dati complessi in robusti modelli di dati UML che formano la base dei prodotti BFI.

• supporta l'evoluzione dei modelli di distribuzione dei dati, tra cui la prima consegna API e l'attivazione dell'accesso ai dati AI.

• lavorare a stretto contatto con i nostri stakeholder di Gestione della Qualità, per guidare l'adozione del modello di dati e la completezza dei dati.

Che cosa porta

• conoscenza dei dati finanziari: forte comprensione del dominio dei dati finanziari. Ad esempio, dati di riferimento dei titoli, azioni societarie, classificazioni fiscali/regolari o dati di mercato

• competenze tecniche: Esperienza linguistica di programmazione in SQL, Phython e Vbscript, VBA . La competenza dimostrata negli strumenti di modellazione dati aziendali UML come Sparx EA (idealmente), Erwin, PowerDesigner o simili, con esperienza nell'ingegneria avanzata e nella progettazione di database o di data warehouse altamente desiderabile.

• forte comprensione delle migliori pratiche di governance dei dati, come il ruolo dei titolari di dati, amministratori e custodi e dei modelli di dati concettuali e fisici. L'esperienza con i cataloghi di dati è auspicabile, ma non obbligatoria.

• approccio collaborativo e orientato al dettaglio alle attività analitiche e di modellazione. Il team collabora con molte parti interessate e i risultati di queste discussioni devono essere chiaramente tenuti nel Business Data Model.

• fluente in inglese (sia verbale che scritta), tedesco è un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Business Data Architekt

Warschau | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8194

Die Division Financial Information innerhalb der SIX Group ist ein globaler Anbieter von Finanzdaten und Analysen für die globale Finanzdienstleistungsbranche. Diese Rolle ist Teil der Business-led Product Development Division und konzentriert sich auf unser Geschäftsdatenmodell, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Finanzdatenprodukte den Kunden-, Handels- und regulatorischen Anforderungen entsprechen. Die Rolle ist eng mit Produktteams, KMU und Operations als wichtige Stakeholder verbunden.

Wir suchen einen Datenarchitekten mit UML-Geschäftsdatenmodell-Erfahrung, der innerhalb der Financial Information Product Delivery-Gruppe für eine praktische Rollenaktualisierung und Wartung unseres Geschäftsdatenmodells arbeitet. Dies umfasst die Gestaltung von konzeptionellen Datenmodellen und eine gründliche Analyse der Daten, die sie untermauern. Das Team erstellt auch physische Schemata, so dass Erfahrung oder Interesse an der Erstellung von JSON-Schemata aus konzeptionellen Modellen ein Plus sind!

``

Was Sie tun werden

• Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen zusammen, um die konzeptionellen Datenmodelle für Finanzinformationen zu überprüfen, zu aktualisieren und zu entwerfen und Klassendefinitionen, Standards und Assoziationssemantik zu definieren.

• Entwicklung und Pflege von Design-, Namenskonventionen, Wörterbüchern, Abstammungs- und Metadatenstandards in Zusammenarbeit mit Datenqualitätsteams, um sicherzustellen, dass Modelle Validierungsregeln unterstützen.

• Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen, um komplexe Datenkonzepte und -anforderungen in robuste UML-Datenmodelle zu übersetzen, die die Grundlage für BFI-Produkte bilden.

• Unterstützung der Entwicklung von Datenverteilungsmodellen, einschließlich API-First Delivery und AI Data Access Enablement.

• eng mit unseren Stakeholdern des Qualitätsmanagements zusammenarbeiten, um die Einführung des Datenmodells und die Vollständigkeit der Daten voranzutreiben.

Was du mitbringst

• Wissen über Finanzdaten: Starkes Verständnis des Finanzdatenbereichs. Zum Beispiel Wertpapierreferenzdaten, Kapitalmaßnahmen, steuerliche/regulatorische Klassifizierungen oder Marktdaten

• Technische Fähigkeiten: Programmieren Spracherfahrung in SQL, Phython und Vbscript, VBA . Nachgewiesene Kenntnisse in UML Business Data Modeling Tools wie Sparx EA (idealerweise), Erwin, PowerDesigner oder ähnlichem, mit Erfahrung im Forward Engineering und Datenbank- oder Data Warehouse-Design sehr wünschenswert.

• Ein fundiertes Verständnis der bewährten Praktiken im Bereich Data Governance wie der Rolle von Dateneigentümern, Verwaltern und Verwahrern sowie von konzeptionellen und physischen Datenmodellen. Erfahrung mit Datenkatalogen ist wünschenswert, aber nicht obligatorisch.

• kollaborativer und detailorientierter Ansatz für analytische und Modellierungsaufgaben. Das Team arbeitet mit vielen Stakeholdern zusammen und die Ergebnisse dieser Diskussionen müssen klar im Geschäftsdatenmodell festgehalten werden.

• fließend Englisch (sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich), Deutsch ist ein Plus.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Anthony Mills unter +44 207 550 5407 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Architecte de données d'affaires

Varsovie : travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% Référence 8194

La division Information financière au sein de SIX Group est un fournisseur mondial de données financières et d'analyses pour le secteur mondial des services financiers. Ce rôle fait partie de la division Développement de produits dirigé par les entreprises et se concentre sur notre modèle de données d'affaires, assurant que nos produits de données financières répondent aux besoins des clients, commerciaux et réglementaires. Le rôle est étroitement lié aux équipes de produits, aux PME et aux opérations en tant qu'intervenants clés.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un Architecte de données avec l'expérience de modèle de données d'entreprise UML pour travailler au sein du Groupe de livraison de produits d'information financière pour une mise à jour de rôle et le maintien de notre modèle de données d'affaires. Cela englobe la conception de modèles de données conceptuelles et l'analyse approfondie des données qui les sous-tendent. L'équipe crée également des schémas physiques, donc l'expérience ou l'intérêt pour créer des schémas JSON à partir de modèles conceptuels est un plus!

``

Ce que vous ferez

• collaborer avec les intervenants de l'ensemble de l'entreprise pour examiner, mettre à jour et concevoir les modèles conceptuels de données pour l'information financière, définir les définitions de classes, les normes et la sémantique d'association.

• élaborer et maintenir des normes de conception, de désignation de conventions, de dictionnaires, de lignage et de métadonnées, en collaborant avec des équipes de qualité des données pour s'assurer que les modèles appuient les règles de validation.

• établir des partenariats avec les intervenants de l'ensemble de l'entreprise pour traduire les concepts et les exigences complexes en modèles de données UML robustes qui constituent la base des produits BFI.

• soutenir l'évolution des modèles de distribution des données, y compris la première livraison d'API et l'accès aux données d'IA.

• travailler en étroite collaboration avec nos intervenants en gestion de la qualité, afin de favoriser l'adoption du modèle de données et l'exhaustivité des données.

Ce que vous apportez

• connaissance des données financières: bonne compréhension du domaine des données financières. Par exemple, données de référence sur les valeurs mobilières, actions des sociétés, classifications fiscales/réglementaires ou données sur le marché

• compétences techniques: Expérience de langage de programmation en SQL, Phython et Vbscript, VBA . Compétence démontrée dans les outils de modélisation de données commerciales UML tels que Sparx EA (idéalement), Erwin, PowerDesigner ou similaire, avec une expérience dans l'ingénierie avancée et la conception de bases de données ou d'entrepôt de données hautement souhaitable.

• une bonne compréhension des pratiques exemplaires en matière de gouvernance des données, telles que le rôle des détenteurs de données, des gestionnaires et des gardiens et des modèles de données conceptuelles et physiques. L'expérience des catalogues de données est souhaitable, mais non obligatoire.

• approche collaborative et détaillée des tâches d'analyse et de modélisation. L'équipe collabore avec de nombreux intervenants et les résultats de ces discussions doivent être clairement consignés dans le modèle de données d'affaires.

• L'allemand est un plus.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Anthony Mills au +44 207 550 5407 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Senior Tax Expert
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Tax Expert

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7955

Are you interested in working in a highly dynamic environment with international tax exposure? We are looking for an experienced Senior Tax Specialist to join our Group Tax / Tax Management team in Spain. This role requires a self-driven professional who independently manages key tax matters, including tax compliance, tax planning, and advisory support to the group on topics such as restructurings and acquisitions. A particular focus lies on FATCA and QI compliance, where deep expertise and practical experience are essential. Beyond this, you will cover a wide spectrum of responsibilities within an international tax function.

What You Will Do

• Own and manage FATCA and QI compliance processes, including reporting, controls, and coordination with key stakeholders such as the tax operations teams in Switzerland

• Oversee EU DAC obligations, ensuring accurate data validation, documentation, and regulatory submissions

• Act as a tax business partner to BSS Business Units, providing advisory support on products, services, and operational tax matters

• Collaborate closely with Swiss and Spanish teams to align processes and ensure consistent tax governance standards

• Support transfer pricing topics, including data preparation, documentation, and coordination with internal experts

• Take responsibility for corporate tax compliance and tax reporting across relevant entities

• Contribute to tax planning initiatives and provide support on group-wide projects, including restructurings and M&A activities

• Provide comprehensive tax advice on a broad range of international and local tax matters within the group

What You Bring

• Degree in Tax, Business, or Economics with hands-on experience in FATCA, QI, and tax compliance frameworks

• Solid experience in international or regulated environments with exposure to EU or US tax reporting obligations

• Ability to work independently with structured and reliable approach in compliance-driven environments

• Strong communication skills to collaborate across teams and explain complex tax matters to internal and external stakeholders clearly

• Needed Language Skills: English and Spanish

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

A particular focus lies on FATCA and QI compliance, where deep expertise and practical experience are essential. Beyond this, you will cover a wide spectrum of responsibilities within an international tax function. What You Will Do
• Own and manage FATCA and QI compliance processes, including reporting, controls, and coordination with key stakeholders such as the tax operations teams in Switzerland
• Oversee EU DAC obligations, ensuring accurate data validation, documentation, and regulatory submissions
• Act as a tax business partner to BSS Business Units, providing advisory support on products, services, and operational tax matters
• Collaborate closely with Swiss and Spanish teams to align processes and ensure consistent tax governance standards
• Support transfer pricing topics, including data preparation, documentation, and coordination with internal experts
• Take responsibility for corporate tax compliance and tax reporting across relevant entities
• Contribute to tax planning initiatives and provide support on group-wide projects, including restructurings and M&A activities
• Provide comprehensive tax advice on a broad range of international and local tax matters within the group What You Bring
• Degree in Tax, Business, or Economics with hands-on experience in FATCA, QI, and tax compliance frameworks
• Solid experience in international or regulated environments with exposure to EU or US tax reporting obligations
• Ability to work independently with structured and reliable approach in compliance-driven environments
• Strong communication skills to collaborate across teams and explain complex tax matters to internal and external stakeholders clearly
• Needed Language Skills: English and Spanish If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. /*Sty

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Warsaw |  80-100% | Reference 8240

Are you passionate about working with Fund data and being involved in the financial markets? Do you possess strong problem-solving skills, and a desire to influence others and drive change? We are looking for a dedicated team player to join our team within SIX Financial Information to support and improve the processes for onboarding Fund Full Holdings data.

To help you achieve your goals, you will have the support of the product management team, and will benefit from partnering with product development, support/operations, project management, customer support as required. Additionally, you may be working with external partners on implementing and interconnecting data, solutions and analytical workflows.

This is a full-time position based in Warsaw, offering the opportunity for remote work 40% of the time as part of our hybrid working model.

Join us at SIX and make your impact with financial data!

What You Will Do

• Support and coordinate the onboarding of fund data providers and services, including file analysis, configuration, testing, and production deployment.

• Ensure operational excellence by maintaining data quality and service performance across fund data products.

• Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to enhance efficiency, scalability, and data quality.

• Manage stakeholder relationships and onboarding requirements, while serving as the escalation point for complex operational issues.

• Contribute to the development of new analytics, products, and data services to support business growth and innovation.

What You Bring

• Strong knowledge of multiple asset classes, including mutual funds, equities, fixed income, and derivatives, with a particular focus on funds.

• Good understanding of fund portfolio holdings, fund data structures, and key fund analytics and indicators.

• Experience in Fund Administration, Asset Management Operations, or a middle-office environment is an advantage.

• Strong analytical, technical, and problem-solving skills, with a structured and methodical approach to work.

• Customer-focused and collaborative team player who is motivated, organized, inquisitive, and demonstrates a proactive "can-do" attitude.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a dare forma al futuro della finanza con noi.

Analista aziendale

Varsavia | 80-100%| Riferimento 8240

Ti appassiona lavorare con i dati dei fondi ed essere coinvolto nei mercati finanziari? Possiedi forti capacità di problem solving e il desiderio di influenzare gli altri e guidare il cambiamento? Cerchiamo un membro del team dedicato che si unisca al nostro team all'interno di SIX Financial Information per supportare e migliorare i processi di onboarding dei dati di Fund Full Holdings.

Per aiutarti a raggiungere i tuoi obiettivi, avrai il supporto del team di gestione del prodotto e trarrai vantaggio dalla collaborazione con lo sviluppo del prodotto, il supporto/operazioni, la gestione dei progetti e l'assistenza clienti, come richiesto. Inoltre, potresti collaborare con partner esterni sull'implementazione e l'interconnessione di dati, soluzioni e flussi di lavoro analitici.

Si tratta di una posizione a tempo pieno con sede a Varsavia, che offre l'opportunità di lavoro a distanza il 40% delle volte come parte del nostro modello di lavoro ibrido.

Unisciti a noi su SIX e ottieni il tuo impatto con i dati finanziari!

Cosa farai

• Supportare e coordinare l'onboarding dei fornitori e dei servizi di dati sui fondi, tra cui analisi dei file, configurazione, test e distribuzione della produzione.

• Garantire l'eccellenza operativa mantenendo la qualità dei dati e le prestazioni del servizio in tutti i prodotti relativi ai dati dei fondi.

• Promuovere miglioramenti dei processi e iniziative di automazione per migliorare l'efficienza, la scalabilità e la qualità dei dati.

• Gestire le relazioni con le parti interessate e i requisiti di onboarding, fungendo al contempo da punto di escalation per questioni operative complesse.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo di nuovi strumenti di analisi, prodotti e servizi dati per supportare la crescita e l'innovazione del business.

Cosa porti

• Conoscenza approfondita di molteplici classi di attività, inclusi fondi comuni di investimento, azioni, reddito fisso e derivati, con particolare attenzione ai fondi.

• Buona conoscenza delle partecipazioni nel portafoglio dei fondi, delle strutture dei dati dei fondi e delle analisi e degli indicatori chiave dei fondi.

• L'esperienza nell'amministrazione di fondi, nelle operazioni di gestione patrimoniale o in un ambiente di middle-office costituisce un vantaggio.

• Forti capacità analitiche, tecniche e di problem solving, con un approccio strutturato e metodico al lavoro.

• Giocatore di squadra focalizzato sul cliente e collaborativo che è motivato, organizzato, curioso e dimostra un atteggiamento proattivo del "si può fare".

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina delle domande frequenti o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero 48 538 562 645

Per questo posto accettiamo solo candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, cerchiamo di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokaler Verwurzelung und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft des Finanzwesens.

Business-Analyst

Warschau | 80-100 % | Referenz 8240

Arbeiten Sie leidenschaftlich gerne mit Fondsdaten und engagieren Sie sich auf den Finanzmärkten? Verfügen Sie über ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten und den Wunsch, andere zu beeinflussen und Veränderungen voranzutreiben? Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem engagierten Teamplayer zur Verstärkung unseres Teams bei SIX Financial Information, der die Prozesse für das Onboarding von Fund Full Holdings-Daten unterstützt und verbessert.

Um Sie beim Erreichen Ihrer Ziele zu unterstützen, erhalten Sie die Unterstützung des Produktmanagementteams und profitieren bei Bedarf von der Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung, Support/Betrieb, Projektmanagement und Kundensupport. Darüber hinaus arbeiten Sie möglicherweise mit externen Partnern an der Implementierung und Verknüpfung von Daten, Lösungen und Analyseworkflows.

Es handelt sich um eine Vollzeitstelle mit Sitz in Warschau, die im Rahmen unseres hybriden Arbeitsmodells die Möglichkeit bietet, 40 % der Zeit aus der Ferne zu arbeiten.

Kommen Sie zu uns bei SIX und machen Sie mit Finanzdaten Eindruck!

Was Sie tun werden

• Unterstützen und koordinieren Sie das Onboarding von Fondsdatenanbietern und -diensten, einschließlich Dateianalyse, Konfiguration, Tests und Produktionsbereitstellung.

• Sicherstellung operativer Exzellenz durch Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und Serviceleistung aller Fondsdatenprodukte.

• Prozessverbesserungen und Automatisierungsinitiativen vorantreiben, um Effizienz, Skalierbarkeit und Datenqualität zu verbessern.

• Verwalten Sie Stakeholder-Beziehungen und Onboarding-Anforderungen und fungieren Sie gleichzeitig als Eskalationspunkt für komplexe betriebliche Probleme.

• Tragen Sie zur Entwicklung neuer Analysen, Produkte und Datendienste bei, um Geschäftswachstum und Innovation zu unterstützen.

Was Sie mitbringen

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse mehrerer Anlageklassen, darunter Investmentfonds, Aktien, festverzinsliche Wertpapiere und Derivate, mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf Fonds.

• Gutes Verständnis der Fondsportfoliobestände, der Fondsdatenstrukturen sowie der wichtigsten Fondsanalysen und -indikatoren.

• Erfahrung in der Fondsverwaltung, der Vermögensverwaltung oder einer Middle-Office-Umgebung ist von Vorteil.

• Starke analytische, technische und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten mit einem strukturierten und methodischen Arbeitsansatz.

• Kundenorientierter und kooperativer Teamplayer, der motiviert, organisiert und neugierig ist und eine proaktive „Can-Do“-Einstellung zeigt.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, schauen Sie sich unsere FAQ-Seite an oder rufen Sie Agnieszka Leputa unter 48 538 562 645 an

Für diese Stelle nehmen wir ausschließlich Direktbewerbungen entgegen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Ihrem persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX pilote la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste d'affaires

Varsovie | 80-100% | Référence 8240

Êtes-vous passionné par le travail avec les données des fonds et par votre implication sur les marchés financiers ? Possédez-vous de solides compétences en résolution de problèmes et un désir d’influencer les autres et de susciter le changement ? Nous recherchons un joueur d'équipe dédié pour rejoindre notre équipe au sein de SIX Financial Information afin de soutenir et d'améliorer les processus d'intégration des données Fund Full Holdings.

Pour vous aider à atteindre vos objectifs, vous bénéficierez du soutien de l'équipe de gestion de produits et bénéficierez de partenariats avec le développement de produits, le support/opérations, la gestion de projet et le support client selon les besoins. De plus, vous travaillerez peut-être avec des partenaires externes sur la mise en œuvre et l'interconnexion de données, de solutions et de flux de travail analytiques.

Il s'agit d'un poste à temps plein basé à Varsovie, offrant la possibilité de travailler à distance 40 % du temps dans le cadre de notre modèle de travail hybride.

Rejoignez-nous chez SIX et ayez un impact grâce aux données financières !

Ce que vous ferez

• Soutenir et coordonner l'intégration des fournisseurs et services de données de fonds, y compris l'analyse des fichiers, la configuration, les tests et le déploiement en production.

• Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle en maintenant la qualité des données et la performance des services pour l'ensemble des produits de données de fonds.

• Piloter l'amélioration des processus et les initiatives d'automatisation pour améliorer l'efficacité, l'évolutivité et la qualité des données.

• Gérer les relations avec les parties prenantes et les exigences d'intégration, tout en servant de point d'escalade pour les problèmes opérationnels complexes.

• Contribuer au développement de nouveaux produits, analyses et services de données pour soutenir la croissance et l'innovation de l'entreprise.

Ce que vous apportez

• Solide connaissance de plusieurs classes d'actifs, notamment les fonds communs de placement, les actions, les titres à revenu fixe et les produits dérivés, avec un accent particulier sur les fonds.

• Bonne compréhension des titres du portefeuille de fonds, des structures de données des fonds et des analyses et indicateurs clés des fonds.

• Une expérience en administration de fonds, en opérations de gestion d'actifs ou dans un environnement de middle-office est un avantage.

• Solides compétences analytiques, techniques et de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche de travail structurée et méthodique.

• Esprit d'équipe axé sur le client et collaboratif, motivé, organisé, curieux et démontrant une attitude proactive et positive.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au 48 538 562 645.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des candidatures indépendamment de toute expérience personnelle.

jobs.title: Index Customer Administration Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Index Customer Administration Specialist

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Reference 8239

Du arbeitest für den Geschäftsbereich Index Services und bist verantwortlich für alle unterstützenden und administrativen Tätigkeiten im Index Business und Sales Support. Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Kunden, Datenmanagement, Finanzprodukten und Compliance. Ein erfahrenes und engagiertes Team unterstützt dich dabei, die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Stakeholder in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Kundenstammpflege, Vertragsmanagement, Gebührenverrechnung und Mahnwesen; Freigabe von Daten/Services gemäss Kundenvereinbarungen

• Bearbeitung von Themen in Compliance, Legal und Quellensteuer; enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachstellen

• First Level Support hinsichtlich Finanzprodukten, Indexdaten, kommerziellen Vereinbarungen und technische Fragen; Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Daten-Vendoren und Geschäftspartnern

• Konsolidierung/Überwachung indexbasierter Produkte (Fonds, strukturierte Produkte, Derivate); Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsprozessen, regulatorischen Berichten und Prozessdokumentationen

• Durchführung von Analysen, Statistiken und Reports; Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und strategischen Umsatzinitiativen; allgemeine Administration

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung; relevante Berufserfahrung im Finanzsektor

• Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung sowie professionelles, überzeugendes Auftreten und klare Kommunikation

• Hohe Genauigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise; souverän im Management komplexer administrativer Aufgaben

• Starke Organisationsfähigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und den Überblick zu behalten

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Spanisch von Vorteil); sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Erfahrung ist ein grosses Plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Architect

London |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry.  This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced.  This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

•    Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
•    Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
•    Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
•    Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
•    Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

What You Bring

•    Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf).  Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
•    5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
•    Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
•    Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential.  Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
•    Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.  It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a dare forma al futuro della finanza con noi.

Architetto dati senior

Londra | lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 7637

La divisione Informazioni finanziarie all'interno del Gruppo SIX è un fornitore globale di dati e analisi finanziari per il settore dei servizi finanziari globale. Questo ruolo si trova all'interno della divisione Sviluppo prodotti guidata dal business e si concentra sull'architettura dei dati aziendali, garantendo che i nostri prodotti di dati finanziari soddisfino le esigenze dei clienti, commerciali e normative. Il ruolo collabora strettamente con l'architettura IT in quanto stakeholder chiave, ma non fa parte della funzione IT.

Cerchiamo un architetto di dati esperto che lavori all'interno del gruppo di distribuzione dei prodotti di informazioni finanziarie per fornire la leadership dell'architettura dei dati in tutta l'azienda per garantire che i nostri prodotti di dati offrano valore ai nostri clienti e possano essere prontamente mantenuti e migliorati. Ciò comprende la progettazione e l'architettura di modelli e schemi di dati logici e fisici, meccanismi di trasporto dei dati, gestione dei metadati, gestione del lignaggio, progettazione di schemi API e abilitazione dell'accesso delle informazioni finanziarie SIX agli agenti AI.

Cosa farai

• Progettare, sviluppare e mantenere modelli di dati canonici/concettuali indipendenti dalla tecnologia e allineati al business per le informazioni finanziarie, definendo definizioni di classi, standard e semantica di associazione.
• Fornire competenze in materia di architettura dei dati a tutti i team di distribuzione per garantire la creazione di prodotti dati che soddisfino le aspettative dei clienti, possano essere facilmente mantenuti e migliorati e disponiamo di una base fondamentale su cui possiamo facilmente costruire nuovi prodotti che generano entrate.
• Sviluppare e mantenere progettazione, convenzioni di denominazione, dizionari, standard di derivazione e metadati, collaborando con i team di qualità dei dati per garantire che i modelli supportino le regole di convalida.
• Collaborare con le parti interessate in tutta l'azienda per tradurre concetti e requisiti di dati complessi in solidi prodotti di dati che i clienti desiderano acquistare, contribuendo al contempo al processo di governance dell'architettura.
• Supportare l'evoluzione dei modelli di distribuzione dei dati, inclusa la distribuzione API-first e l'abilitazione dell'accesso ai dati tramite intelligenza artificiale.

Cosa porti

• Esperienza pratica nella progettazione di schemi per database relazionali, messaggistica, data lake/lakehouse (Databricks, Snowflake o equivalenti) e formati API/messaggio (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Ottima conoscenza dei metadati e della gestione del lignaggio.
• Oltre 5 anni di esperienza o capacità dimostrata di soddisfare i requisiti di modellazione dei dati, architettura dei dati o una disciplina strettamente correlata all'interno dei servizi finanziari con competenza negli strumenti di modellazione dei dati UML come Sparx EA (idealmente), Erwin, PowerDesigner o simili
• Ottima conoscenza del dominio dei dati finanziari: dati di riferimento sui titoli, azioni societarie, dati di mercato e classificazioni normative, reddito fisso sarebbero altamente auspicabili
• La comprensione dei principi di progettazione API (REST, GraphQL) e delle strategie di evoluzione dello schema per la compatibilità con le versioni precedenti è essenziale. È auspicabile un’esperienza diretta nel rendere i dati commercialmente disponibili agli agenti di intelligenza artificiale.
• Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese (sia verbale che scritto), il tedesco è un vantaggio. È essenziale che la persona in questo ruolo sia in grado di comunicare chiaramente concetti complessi e strutture di dati a un'ampia gamma di parti interessate.

descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Data Architect

London | working from home up to 40% | Reference 7637

The Financial Information division within SIX Group is a global provider of financial data and analytics to the global financial services industry. This role sits within the Business-led Product Development division and focuses on business data architecture, ensuring our financial data products meet customer, commercial and regulatory needs. The role partners closely with IT Architecture as a key stakeholder but is not part of the IT function.

We are looking for an experienced data architect to work within the Financial Information Product Delivery group to provide data architecture leadership across the firm to ensure our data products deliver value to our customers and they can be readily maintained and enhanced. This encompasses the design and architecture of logical and physical data models and schemas, data transport mechanisms, metadata management, lineage management, API schema design and enabling SIX financial information to be accessible to AI agents.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop and maintain the technology-agnostic, business-aligned canonical/conceptual data models for Financial Information, defining class definitions, standards and association semantics.
• Provide data architecture expertise to all delivery teams to ensure we build data products that meet customer expectations, can be readily maintained and enhanced, and we have a core foundation on which we can readily build new revenue generating products.
• Develop and maintain design, naming conventions, dictionaries, lineage and metadata standards, collaborating with data quality teams to ensure models support validation rules.
• Partner with stakeholders across the business to translate complex data concepts and requirements into robust data products that customers want to purchase whilst contributing to the architectural governance process.
• Support the evolution of data distribution models, including API-first delivery and AI data access enablement.

What You Bring

• Hands-on experience designing schemas for relational databases, messaging, data lakes/lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent), and API/message formats (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Strong understanding of metadata and lineage management.
• 5+ years of experience, or demonstrated delivery against requirements in data modelling, data architecture, or a closely related discipline within financial services with proficiency in UML data modelling tools such as Sparx EA (ideally), Erwin, PowerDesigner or similar
• Strong understanding of the financial data domain: securities reference data, corporate actions, market data, and regulatory classifications, fixed income would be highly desirable
• Understanding of API design principles (REST, GraphQL) and schema evolution strategies for backward compatibility is essential. Direct experience of making data commercially available to AI agents is desirable.
• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus. It is essential that the person in this role is able to clearly communicate complex concepts and data structures to a wide range of stakeholders.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
