Leitender Datenarchitekt

London | Heimarbeit bis zu 40 % | Referenz 7637

Der Bereich Financial Information innerhalb der SIX Group ist ein globaler Anbieter von Finanzdaten und -analysen für die globale Finanzdienstleistungsbranche. Diese Rolle ist innerhalb der geschäftsorientierten Produktentwicklungsabteilung angesiedelt und konzentriert sich auf die Geschäftsdatenarchitektur, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Finanzdatenprodukte den Kunden-, Geschäfts- und Regulierungsanforderungen entsprechen. Die Rolle arbeitet eng mit der IT-Architektur als Hauptakteur zusammen, ist jedoch nicht Teil der IT-Funktion.

Wir sind auf der Suche nach einem erfahrenen Datenarchitekten, der in der Gruppe „Financial Information Product Delivery“ arbeitet und unternehmensweit eine Führungsrolle bei der Datenarchitektur übernimmt, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Datenprodukte unseren Kunden einen Mehrwert bieten und problemlos gewartet und verbessert werden können. Dies umfasst das Design und die Architektur logischer und physischer Datenmodelle und -schemata, Datentransportmechanismen, Metadatenverwaltung, Herkunftsverwaltung, API-Schema-Design und ermöglicht den Zugriff auf SIX-Finanzinformationen für KI-Agenten.

Was Sie tun werden

• Entwerfen, entwickeln und pflegen Sie die technologieunabhängigen, geschäftsorientierten kanonischen/konzeptionellen Datenmodelle für Finanzinformationen und definieren Sie Klassendefinitionen, Standards und Assoziationssemantik.
• Stellen Sie allen Bereitstellungsteams Fachwissen zur Datenarchitektur zur Verfügung, um sicherzustellen, dass wir Datenprodukte entwickeln, die den Erwartungen der Kunden entsprechen, leicht gewartet und erweitert werden können und über eine zentrale Grundlage verfügen, auf der wir problemlos neue umsatzgenerierende Produkte aufbauen können.
• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie Design, Namenskonventionen, Wörterbücher, Abstammungs- und Metadatenstandards und arbeiten Sie mit Datenqualitätsteams zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass Modelle Validierungsregeln unterstützen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern im gesamten Unternehmen zusammen, um komplexe Datenkonzepte und -anforderungen in robuste Datenprodukte zu übersetzen, die Kunden kaufen möchten, und tragen Sie gleichzeitig zum Architektur-Governance-Prozess bei.
• Unterstützen Sie die Entwicklung von Datenverteilungsmodellen, einschließlich der API-First-Bereitstellung und der Aktivierung des KI-Datenzugriffs.

Was Sie mitbringen

• Praktische Erfahrung im Entwerfen von Schemata für relationale Datenbanken, Messaging, Data Lakes/Lakehouses (Databricks, Snowflake oder gleichwertig) und API/Nachrichtenformate (JSON Schema, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Ausgeprägtes Verständnis von Metadaten und Herkunftsmanagement.

• Kenntnisse der API-Designprinzipien (REST, GraphQL) und Schemaentwicklungsstrategien für die Abwärtskompatibilität sind unerlässlich. Direkte Erfahrung in der kommerziellen Bereitstellung von Daten für KI-Agenten ist wünschenswert.
• Fließende Englischkenntnisse (in Wort und Schrift), Deutsch ist ein Plus. Es ist wichtig, dass die Person in dieser Rolle in der Lage ist, komplexe Konzepte und Datenstrukturen einem breiten Spektrum von Interessengruppen klar zu vermitteln.

Architecte de données senior

Londres | travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% | Référence 7637

La division Financial Information au sein de SIX Group est un fournisseur mondial de données et d'analyses financières pour le secteur mondial des services financiers. Ce rôle s'inscrit au sein de la division Développement de produits dirigés par l'entreprise et se concentre sur l'architecture des données d'entreprise, garantissant que nos produits de données financières répondent aux besoins des clients, commerciaux et réglementaires. Le rôle s'associe étroitement à l'architecture informatique en tant que partie prenante clé, mais ne fait pas partie de la fonction informatique.

Nous recherchons un architecte de données expérimenté pour travailler au sein du groupe de livraison de produits d'informations financières afin de fournir un leadership en matière d'architecture de données dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise afin de garantir que nos produits de données apportent de la valeur à nos clients et qu'ils peuvent être facilement maintenus et améliorés. Cela englobe la conception et l'architecture de modèles et de schémas de données logiques et physiques, les mécanismes de transport de données, la gestion des métadonnées, la gestion du lignage, la conception de schémas d'API et l'accès aux informations financières de SIX aux agents d'IA.

Ce que vous ferez

• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des modèles de données canoniques/conceptuels, indépendants de la technologie et alignés sur l'entreprise, pour les informations financières, en définissant les définitions de classe, les normes et la sémantique des associations.
• Fournir une expertise en architecture de données à toutes les équipes de livraison pour garantir que nous construisons des produits de données qui répondent aux attentes des clients, peuvent être facilement maintenus et améliorés, et que nous disposons d'une base de base sur laquelle nous pouvons facilement créer de nouveaux produits générateurs de revenus.
• Développer et maintenir la conception, les conventions de dénomination, les dictionnaires, les normes de lignage et de métadonnées, en collaborant avec les équipes de qualité des données pour garantir que les modèles prennent en charge les règles de validation.
• Collaborer avec les parties prenantes de l'entreprise pour traduire des concepts et des exigences de données complexes en produits de données robustes que les clients souhaitent acheter tout en contribuant au processus de gouvernance architecturale.
• Prendre en charge l'évolution des modèles de distribution de données, y compris la fourniture d'API et l'activation de l'accès aux données par l'IA.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience pratique en conception de schémas pour bases de données relationnelles, messagerie, lacs/lakehouses de données (Databricks, Snowflake ou équivalent) et formats d'API/messages (Schéma JSON, OpenAPI, Avro, Protobuf). Solide compréhension des métadonnées et de la gestion du lignage.
• Plus de 5 années d'expérience, ou satisfaction démontrée des exigences en matière de modélisation de données, d'architecture de données ou dans une discipline étroitement liée au sein des services financiers, avec une maîtrise des outils de modélisation de données UML tels que Sparx EA (idéalement), Erwin, PowerDesigner ou similaire.
• Une solide compréhension du domaine des données financières : données de référence sur les titres, opérations sur titres, données de marché et classifications réglementaires, titres à revenu fixe serait hautement souhaitable.
• La compréhension des principes de conception d'API (REST, GraphQL) et des stratégies d'évolution des schémas pour une compatibilité ascendante est essentielle. Une expérience directe de la mise à disposition commerciale de données aux agents d’IA est souhaitable.
• Anglais courant (à l'oral et à l'écrit), l'allemand est un plus. Il est essentiel que la personne occupant ce rôle soit capable de communiquer clairement des concepts et des structures de données complexes à un large éventail de parties prenantes.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Anthony Mills au +44 207 550 5407.

Pour ce poste vacant, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des candidatures indépendamment de toute expérience personnelle.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

API Platform Engineer, Kong API & AI Gateway

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8187

Join our international platform team in Madrid and help application teams expose APIs and connect to AI services securely through a critical shared Kong platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a pure administration position. You will operate Kong in production, reduce toil through automation and build self-service paths for API onboarding and policy delivery.

The role suits an experienced engineer who already handles production topics independently and wants to broaden technical ownership. Direct Kong experience is welcome. Experience with another API gateway is equally relevant. What You'll Build First: Turn Kong AI Gateway into a production-ready service that gives application teams a secure, observable and self-service path to LLM and MCP connectivity. Build the guardrails for policy enforcement, traffic routing, rate limiting, auditability and reliable operations.

What You Will Do

• Operate and continuously improve our business-critical Kong API Gateway across OpenSnd Microsoft Azure, including incidents, changes, upgrades, security, capacity and lifecycle management.

• Design and build automation and self-service capabilities that make API onboarding, policy delivery and platform changes safer, faster and more consistent.

• Develop platform services and tooling using APIs, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code.

• Establish actionable observability across metrics, logs and traces using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana and the Elastic Stack, and strengthen API security through policies, certificates, secrets and modern identity standards.

• Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root-cause analysis and turn operational learnings into durable platform improvements.

• Share on-call responsibility for the platform and use incidents to eliminate recurring operational toil.

What You Bring

• You do not need experience with every tool listed below. We are looking for solid production judgment, curiosity and the ability to take ownership.

• Hands-on experience operating an API gateway in a production environment.

• Strong production experience with Kubernetes or OpenShift and Microsoft Azure and services such as AKS and Entra ID.

• Proven automation skills using GitOps, CI/CD and infrastructure or configuration as code, with tools such as Terraform, Helm, Argo CD or GitLab CI.

• Software engineering or scripting experience. Go for Terraform integrations or Java and Spring Boot for self-service platform development is advantageous.

• Solid knowledge of networking, TLS, certificates, secrets and identity standards such as OAuth and OIDC.

• Experience with observability, incident response and root-cause analysis in business-critical, regulated environments. Knowledge of OpenTelemetry is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

API Platform Engineer, Kong API & AI Gateway

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8187

Unisciti al nostro team di piattaforma internazionale a Madrid e aiuta i team delle applicazioni a esporre le API e a connettersi ai servizi AI in modo sicuro attraverso una piattaforma di Kong condivisa critica.

Questo è un ruolo ingegneristico pratico, non una pura posizione di amministrazione. Potrai operare Kong in produzione, ridurre il toil attraverso l'automazione e costruire percorsi self-service per l'inserimento API e la consegna dei criteri.

Il ruolo si adatta a un ingegnere esperto che già gestisce gli argomenti di produzione indipendentemente e vuole ampliare la proprietà tecnica. L'esperienza diretta di Kong è gradita. L'esperienza con un altro gateway API è altrettanto rilevante. Cosa costruirai per primo: trasformare Kong AI Gateway in un servizio pronto alla produzione che offre ai team di applicazioni un percorso sicuro, osservabile e self-service per la connettività LLM e MCP. Costruire i guardrails per l'applicazione delle politiche, routing del traffico, limitazione dei tassi, verificabilità e operazioni affidabili.

Cosa farai

• Operare e migliorare continuamente il nostro business-critical Kong API Gateway attraverso OpenSnd Microsoft Azure, compresi incidenti, modifiche, aggiornamenti, sicurezza, capacità e gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Progettazione e costruzione di funzionalità di automazione e self-service che rendono l'API onboarding, la consegna di policy e la piattaforma cambia più sicuro, più veloce e più coerente.

• Sviluppare servizi di piattaforma e strumenti utilizzando API, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines e infrastrutture come codice.

• Stabilire l'osservabilità attuabile attraverso metriche, registri e tracce utilizzando OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana e lo Stack Elastico, e rafforzare la sicurezza API attraverso politiche, certificati, segreti e moderni standard di identità.

• Risoluzione problemi complessi problemi di produzione, eseguire analisi causa root e trasformare gli apprendimento operativi in miglioramenti della piattaforma duraturi.

• Share on-call responsabilità per la piattaforma e utilizzare incidenti per eliminare il toil operativo ricorrente.

Che cosa porta

• Non hai bisogno di esperienza con tutti gli strumenti elencati di seguito. Stiamo cercando un giudizio di produzione solido, una curiosità e la capacità di prendere possesso.

• Esperienza pratica che opera un gateway API in un ambiente di produzione.

• Forte esperienza di produzione con Kubernetes o OpenShift e Microsoft Azure e servizi come AKS e Entra ID.

• Prove abilità di automazione utilizzando GitOps, CI/CD e infrastruttura o configurazione come codice, con strumenti come Terraform, Helm, Argo CD o GitLab CI.

• Ingegneria software o esperienza di scrittura. Vai per le integrazioni Terraform o Java e Spring Boot per lo sviluppo della piattaforma self-service è vantaggioso.

• Conoscenza solida di rete, TLS, certificati, segreti e standard di identità come OAuth e OIDC.

• Esperienza con osservabilità, risposta agli incidenti e analisi di root-cause in ambienti business-critical e regolamentati. La conoscenza di OpenTelemetry è un plus.

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Was Sie tun werden

• Bewährte Automatisierungskenntnisse mit GitOps, CI/CD und Infrastruktur oder Konfiguration als Code, mit Tools wie Terraform, Helm, Argo CD oder GitLab CI.

Ingénieur API Platform, Kong API & AI Gateway

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8187

Rejoignez notre équipe internationale de plateforme à Madrid et aidez les équipes d'applications à exposer les API et à se connecter en toute sécurité aux services d'IA grâce à une plateforme partagée critique à Kong.

Il s'agit d'un rôle pratique d'ingénierie, et non d'une simple fonction d'administration. Vous exploiterez Kong dans la production, réduirez le travail grâce à l'automatisation et construire des chemins en libre-service pour l'API à bord et la livraison des politiques.

Ce rôle convient à un ingénieur expérimenté qui s'occupe déjà de sujets de production de manière indépendante et veut élargir la propriété technique. L'expérience directe de Kong est la bienvenue. L'expérience avec une autre passerelle API est tout aussi pertinente. Ce que vous allez construire d'abord: Transformez Kong AI Gateway en un service prêt à la production qui donne aux équipes d'applications un chemin sécurisé, observable et en libre-service vers la connectivité LLM et MCP. Construisez les garde-corps pour l'application des politiques, l'acheminement du trafic, la limitation des tarifs, la vérification et les opérations fiables.

Ce que vous ferez

• Exploiter et améliorer continuellement notre interface API Kong critique sur OpenSnd Microsoft Azure, y compris les incidents, les changements, les mises à jour, la sécurité, la capacité et la gestion du cycle de vie.

• Concevoir et construire des capacités d'automatisation et de libre-service qui rendent l'IPA à bord, la prestation des politiques et les changements de plateforme plus sûrs, plus rapides et plus cohérents.

• Élaborer des services de plate-forme et des outils à l'aide des API, des GitOps, des pipelines CI/CD et de l'infrastructure comme code.

• Établir une observabilité actionnable à travers les métriques, les journaux et les traces à l'aide d'OpenTelemetry, Prométheus, Grafana et l'Elastic Stack, et renforcer la sécurité des API grâce à des politiques, des certificats, des secrets et des normes d'identité modernes.

• Résoudre les problèmes de production complexes, analyser les causes profondes et transformer les apprentissages opérationnels en améliorations durables de la plateforme.

• Partager la responsabilité sur appel de la plate-forme et utiliser les incidents pour éliminer le travail opérationnel récurrent.

Ce que vous apportez

• Vous n'avez pas besoin d'expérience avec tous les outils énumérés ci-dessous. Nous sommes à la recherche d'un jugement solide en matière de production, de curiosité et de capacité à prendre possession.

• Expérience pratique en exploitant une passerelle API dans un environnement de production.

• Forte expérience de production avec Kubernetes ou OpenShift et Microsoft Azure et des services tels que AKS et Entra ID.

• Compétences d'automatisation éprouvées utilisant GitOps, CI/CD et infrastructure ou configuration comme code, avec des outils tels que Terraform, Helm, Argo CD ou GitLab CI.

• Ingénierie logicielle ou expérience de script. Allez pour les intégrations Terraform ou Java et Spring Boot pour le développement de plate-formes en libre-service est avantageux.

• Bonne connaissance du réseautage, des TLS, des certificats, des secrets et des normes d'identité comme OAuth et OIDC.

• Expérience de l'observabilité, de l'intervention en cas d'incident et de l'analyse des causes profondes dans des environnements réglementés et critiques. La connaissance d'OpenTelemetry est un plus.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• design, deploy, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• lead the onboarding of teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry instrumentation, collection, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems using OpenTelemetry

• work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• install, configure, fine-tune, and maintain OpenTelemetry Collectors and telemetry pipelines for applications and platforms

• build and maintain dashboards, alerting, and telemetry flows across distributed tracing, metrics, and logs, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• run and evolve observability services that support modern incident detection, investigation, and operational decision-making

• design, configure, and maintain integrations with event management and ticketing systems for alert routing, incident context, and operational workflows

What You Bring

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, including responsibility for production observability capabilities

• proven experience taking observability capabilities from requirements to production-ready solutions; experience limited to dashboards, queries, or observability backends as a consumer is not sufficient

• practical experience instrumenting applications and infrastructure with OpenTelemetry to generate traces, metrics, and logs

• strong understanding of modern, trace-centric observability practices beyond traditional log-centric monitoring

• experience deploying, configuring, and operating OpenTelemetry Collectors and designing telemetry pipelines is a strong advantage; these will be key hands-on responsibilities in the role

• experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads

• experience with common observability toolchains and backends (e.g.: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.) - Elastic Stack experience considered a plus

• scripting or automation skills to support repeatable deployment, configuration, validation, and ongoing operations using technologies such as Helm, Terraform, and Ansible

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

ServiceNow Business Analyst

Warsaw |  Hybrid model | Reference 7870

We are looking for a ServiceNow Business Analyst to support the rollout and ongoing evolution of a greenfield ServiceNow platform and the transformation of service management capabilities at SIX. This is not a short-term or single-module role. It is a platform-focused position supporting the design and delivery of ServiceNow across multiple domains over time. The Business Analyst will work closely with the Product Owner, Platform Architect and business stakeholders to translate prioritized demand into clear, structured requirements, ensuring solutions are scalable, OOTB-first and aligned with the long-term platform vision.

The role supports requirements and process design across several ServiceNow domains within a greenfield platform context, including: ITSM - must, CSM - preferred, CMDB / CSDM - preferred, IRM / GRC - preferred, HRSD - preferred. The candidate does not need to be equally strong across all domains. Experience in several areas is sufficient.

What You Will Do

• gather, analyze and document business and functional requirements in collaboration with stakeholders across ITSM, CSM, CMDB/CSDM, IRM/GRC and HRSD

• run workshops to understand current-state processes, pain points, dependencies and future-state needs

• translate business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and supporting documentation

• support the transformation of processes from legacy tools and practices into the ServiceNow platform

• perform OOTB fit-gap analysis and challenge unnecessary customization early

• identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, redesign, phase or retire processes

• work closely with the Product Owner on backlog refinement and scope clarification

• work closely with the Platform Architect to ensure requirements align with the target-state design and platform guardrails and do not introduce unnecessary customization

• support testing and UAT by preparing scenarios, clarifying defects and validating business outcomes

• maintain documentation including traceability, assumptions, decisions and current-state and future-state process maps

What You Bring

• 3-5 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role

• 2-3 years of experience working on ServiceNow implementations or ServiceNow-enabled transformations, with solid understanding and hands-on experience with ITSM

• experience across several domains such as CSM, IRM / GRC, CMDB / CSDM - a strong plus

• strong experience in requirements gathering, process analysis, user story writing and functional documentation within SDLC environments

• experience documenting current-state and future-state processes

• experience supporting UAT and business validation

• experience in greenfield platform implementations or transformation programs

• experience working in cross-functional environments and with platform governance and organizational change management (OCM)

• strong business analysis and process mapping skills

• good understanding of ServiceNow platform concepts and workflow-based solutions

• ability to translate ambiguous demand into clear, structured requirements

• strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills

• clear written and verbal communication

• ability to work across business, product, architecture and delivery teams

• ServiceNow CSA - preferred

• ITIL Foundation - preferred

• experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Visio or Lucidchart - preferred

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at  +48 538 562 645

.

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8147

• Fluent in German and English (both verbal & writing), Spanish or French is a plus.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Account Manager

Zürich | 80-100% | Referenz 8147

Möchten Sie in einem hochdynamischen Umfeld arbeiten? Sie interessieren sich für Marktdaten? Dann möchte unser Account Management Team von Ihnen hören! Wir sind ein AGILE, DRIVEN und ein internationales Team, das für die Lizenzierung von Marktdaten sowohl von SIX als auch von BME verantwortlich ist. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie eng mit Administration & Intelligence, Legal & Compliance und Operations zusammen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Verantwortlich für das ganzheitliche und serviceorientierte Management bestehender und neuer Kunden im Rahmen eines proaktiven Account Managements.

• Als primäre Anlaufstelle für Kunden, Koordination von funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Produkt, Recht, Betrieb), um eine nahtlose Servicebereitstellung zu gewährleisten, während die Kontoleistung überwacht und Lösungen an den Kundenbedürfnissen und Geschäftszielen ausgerichtet werden.

• Aufbau und Pflege nachhaltiger Kundenbeziehungen.

• Förderung des kommerziellen Wachstums durch Upselling und Cross-Selling von Marktdatendiensten und Value-Added-Analytics-Angeboten.

• Initiieren und unterstützen Sie Kundenaudits und unterstützen Sie den externen Auditor bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Auditaktivitäten.

Was du mitbringst

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche (3-8 Jahre).

• Solider Hintergrund im Marktdatenbereich (z. B. Datenlieferant, Börse oder Bank).

• Erfahrung in Account Management, Sales oder Client Relationship Management.

• Starkes Gefühl von Eigentum und Rechenschaftspflicht.

• Fließend in Deutsch und Englisch (sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich), Spanisch oder Französisch ist ein Plus.

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie German Lopez Arranz unter +34 91 709 5771 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Gestionnaire de comptes

Zurich (80-100%) Référence 8147

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement très dynamique ? Êtes-vous passionné par les données du marché? Alors, notre équipe de gestion de compte veut vous entendre ! Nous sommes une équipe AGILE, DRIVEN et internationale responsable de l'octroi de licences de données de marché pour les personnes morales SIX et BME. Dans ce poste, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Administration & Intelligence, Legal & Compliance and Operations.

Ce que vous ferez

• Responsable de la gestion globale et axée sur les services des clients existants et nouveaux dans le cadre de la gestion proactive des comptes.

• En tant que principal point de contact pour les clients, coordonner les équipes interfonctionnelles (produits, juridiques, opérations) pour assurer la prestation de services sans faille, tout en surveillant le rendement des comptes et en alignant les solutions avec les besoins des clients et les objectifs opérationnels.

• Établir et maintenir des relations durables avec les clients.

• Favoriser la croissance commerciale grâce à la vente et à la vente croisée de services de données de marché et de services d'analyse à valeur ajoutée.

• Entreprendre et appuyer les audits des clients et aider le vérificateur externe à préparer et à exécuter les activités de vérification.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience éprouvée dans le secteur des services financiers (3-8 ans).

• Fondement solide dans le domaine des données du marché (par exemple, fournisseur de données, échange ou banque).

• Expérience en gestion de compte, ventes ou gestion de relation client.

• Fort sentiment d'appropriation et de responsabilité.

• L'espagnol ou le français est un plus.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez German Lopez Arranz au +34 91 709 5771 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Customer Support & AI Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Customer Support & AI Automation Specialist

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7877

In this hybrid role, you combine hands-on customer support with ownership of automation and AI-driven improvements. You handle customer requests, identify opportunities to reduce manual work, and help teams adopt new AI agents and automation solutions. You act as a key contributor in improving customer experience while driving efficiency across support operations.

What You Will Do

• Handle customer support requests with accuracy, professionalism, and a customer-first mindset while ensuring proper categorization and data quality.

• Identify recurring issues, manual activities, and process inefficiencies, proactively recommending opportunities for automation and AI-driven improvements.

• Take ownership of automation initiatives from idea to implementation, designing practical solutions that improve efficiency, service quality, and customer experience.

• Drive adoption of new ways of working by working closely with the team to turn new ideas into everyday practice.

What You Bring

• 2+ years of experience in customer support, service operations, process improvement, or a similar customer-facing environment.

• Hands-on experience with AI solutions, automation platforms, workflow optimization, or related technologies.

• Proven ability to identify process improvement opportunities and translate them into practical automation initiatives.

• Experience driving automation or continuous improvement initiatives from concept through implementation.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to recognize patterns, optimize workflows, and improve customer experience.

• A proactive, self-driven mindset with a passion for innovation, automation, and continuous improvement.

• Fluent English skills

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home | Reference 7950

The Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day operation of the Cyber Security Resilience services, with a strong focus on service desk activities, operational follow-up, and audit support.

The role acts as the first operational layer for File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB), and Vulnerability Management, relieving senior engineers and analysts from administrative, evidentiary, and coordination tasks while ensuring consistency, quality, and audit readiness.

What You Will Do

• Operational & Service Desk Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for service desk requests and tickets related to: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB / CIS Benchmarks), Vulnerability Management activities

• Triage, track, and coordinate operational tickets, ensuring timely handling and clear communication with stakeholders.

• Perform initial analysis and validation of findings (e.g. expected vs. unexpected changes, status of vulnerabilities, baseline deviations) before escalation.

• Maintain operational documentation, runbooks, and FAQs related to Cyber Security Resilience services.

• Tool-Based Operational Activities

• Operate and support Cyber Security Resilience tooling on a daily basis, including retrieving data, validating results, and supporting reporting activities.

• Assist in maintaining data quality and consistency across FIM, SCB, and Vulnerability Management tools.

• Support recurring operational tasks such as: Report generation, Status checks, Evidence extraction, Follow-up tracking

• This role is not responsible for tool engineering, rule development, or architecture, but requires a solid understanding of how the tools work and how results should be interpreted.

• Audit & Compliance Support

• Actively support internal and external audit activities (e.g. FINMA, DORA, internal audits) by extracting audit evidence directly from Cyber Security Resilience tools, ensuring evidence is complete, traceable, and aligned with audit requests, supporting responses to audit questions in coordination with senior team members.

• Maintain structured audit evidence repositories and support continuous audit readiness.

• Help standardise and streamline evidence collection processes to reduce broader team workload.

• Coordination & Stakeholder Support

• Liaise with infrastructure, platform, and operations teams on operational clarifications and ticket follow-ups.

• Support the Cyber Security Resilience team by absorbing operational overhead, allowing engineers and specialists to focus on analysis and improvement initiatives.

• Escalate operational risks, recurring issues, or data gaps to senior team members in a structured manner.

What You Bring

• Solid foundational understanding of cyber security concepts, particularly: Vulnerability management, Secure system configuration / CIS Benchmarks, File integrity and change monitoring

• Hands-on experience working with security or infrastructure tooling, ideally in an operational or service-oriented role.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems, SLAs, and operational support models.

• Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, or evidence collection is a strong advantage.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and reliable in execution.

• Comfortable working with operational data, evidence, and repetitive tasks while maintaining quality.

• Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proactive in identifying inefficiencies or improvement opportunities in operational processes.

• English Fluency

• German advantage

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo una miscela unica di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti brillanti e le ispiriamo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a dare forma al futuro della finanza con noi.

Specialista in operazioni di resilienza della sicurezza informatica

Varsavia | fino al 40% lavora da casa | Riferimento 7950

Lo specialista delle operazioni di resilienza della sicurezza informatica supporta il funzionamento quotidiano dei servizi di resilienza della sicurezza informatica, con una forte attenzione alle attività del service desk, al follow-up operativo e al supporto di audit.

Il ruolo funge da primo livello operativo per il monitoraggio dell'integrità dei file (FIM), la Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB) e la gestione delle vulnerabilità, sollevando ingegneri e analisti senior da compiti amministrativi, probatori e di coordinamento garantendo al contempo coerenza, qualità e disponibilità agli audit.

Cosa farai

• Supporto operativo e del Service Desk

• Agire come punto di contatto primario per richieste e ticket di service desk relativi a: monitoraggio dell'integrità dei file (FIM), baseline di configurazione sicura (benchmark SCB/CIS), attività di gestione delle vulnerabilità

• Triage, monitoraggio e coordinamento dei ticket operativi, garantendo una gestione tempestiva e una comunicazione chiara con le parti interessate.

• Eseguire l'analisi iniziale e la convalida dei risultati (ad esempio cambiamenti previsti rispetto a quelli imprevisti, stato delle vulnerabilità, deviazioni dalla linea di base) prima dell'escalation.

• Conservare la documentazione operativa, i runbook e le domande frequenti relative ai servizi di resilienza della sicurezza informatica.

• Attività operative basate su strumenti

• Utilizzare e supportare quotidianamente gli strumenti di resilienza della sicurezza informatica, compreso il recupero dei dati, la convalida dei risultati e il supporto delle attività di reporting.

• Assistere nel mantenimento della qualità e della coerenza dei dati tra gli strumenti FIM, SCB e di gestione delle vulnerabilità.

• Supportare attività operative ricorrenti quali: generazione di report, controlli di stato, estrazione di prove, monitoraggio del follow-up

• Questo ruolo non è responsabile dell'ingegneria degli strumenti, dello sviluppo delle regole o dell'architettura, ma richiede una solida conoscenza di come funzionano gli strumenti e di come dovrebbero essere interpretati i risultati.

• Supporto per audit e conformità

• Supportare attivamente le attività di audit interno ed esterno (ad esempio FINMA, DORA, audit interni) estraendo prove di audit direttamente dagli strumenti di resilienza della sicurezza informatica, garantendo che le prove siano complete, tracciabili e allineate con le richieste di audit, supportando le risposte alle domande di audit in coordinamento con i membri senior del team.

• Mantenere archivi strutturati di prove di audit e supportare la continua disponibilità all'audit.

• Contribuire a standardizzare e semplificare i processi di raccolta delle prove per ridurre il carico di lavoro del team più ampio.

• Coordinamento e supporto delle parti interessate

• Collaborare con i team dell'infrastruttura, della piattaforma e delle operazioni per chiarimenti operativi e follow-up dei ticket.

• Supportare il team di resilienza della sicurezza informatica assorbendo le spese generali operative, consentendo a ingegneri e specialisti di concentrarsi su iniziative di analisi e miglioramento.

• Inoltrare in modo strutturato i rischi operativi, i problemi ricorrenti o le lacune di dati ai membri senior del team.

Cosa porti

• Solida conoscenza di base dei concetti di sicurezza informatica, in particolare: gestione delle vulnerabilità, configurazione sicura del sistema/benchmark CIS, integrità dei file e monitoraggio delle modifiche

• Esperienza pratica di lavoro con strumenti di sicurezza o infrastruttura, idealmente in un ruolo operativo o orientato ai servizi.

• Familiarità con i sistemi di biglietteria, gli SLA e i modelli di supporto operativo.

• L'esperienza nel supporto di audit, attività di conformità o raccolta di prove costituisce un grande vantaggio.

• Strutturato, attento ai dettagli e affidabile nell'esecuzione.

• Comodità nel lavorare con dati operativi, prove e attività ripetitive mantenendo la qualità.

• In grado di comunicare chiaramente con le parti interessate sia tecniche che non tecniche.

• Proattivo nell'individuare inefficienze o opportunità di miglioramento nei processi operativi.

• Ottima conoscenza dell'inglese

• Vantaggio tedesco

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina delle domande frequenti o chiama Agnieszka Leputa al numero .

Per questo posto accettiamo solo candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, cerchiamo di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft des Finanzwesens.

Spezialist für Cyber Security Resilience Operations

Warsaw | bis zu 40 % im Homeoffice | Reference 7950

Der Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist unterstützt den täglichen Betrieb der Cyber Security Resilience Services mit einem starken Fokus auf Service-Desk-Aktivitäten, operativer Nachverfolgung und Audit-Unterstützung.

Die Rolle fungiert als erste operative Ebene für File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB) und Vulnerability Management und entlastet leitende Ingenieure und Analysten von Verwaltungs-, Beweis- und Koordinierungsaufgaben und stellt gleichzeitig Konsistenz, Qualität und Prüfungsbereitschaft sicher.

Was Sie tun werden

• Betriebs- und Servicedesk-Unterstützung

• Fungieren Sie als Hauptansprechpartner für Service-Desk-Anfragen und Tickets im Zusammenhang mit: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB/CIS Benchmarks), Vulnerability Management-Aktivitäten

• Triage, Verfolgung und Koordinierung von Betriebstickets, um eine rechtzeitige Bearbeitung und klare Kommunikation mit den Beteiligten sicherzustellen.

• Führen Sie vor der Eskalation eine erste Analyse und Validierung der Ergebnisse durch (z. B. erwartete vs. unerwartete Änderungen, Status von Schwachstellen, Basisabweichungen).

• Pflegen Sie Betriebsdokumentationen, Runbooks und FAQs im Zusammenhang mit Cyber ​​Security Resilience-Diensten.

• Toolbasierte operative Aktivitäten

• Betreiben und unterstützen Sie täglich Cyber Security Resilience-Tools, einschließlich des Abrufens von Daten, der Validierung von Ergebnissen und der Unterstützung von Berichtsaktivitäten.

• Unterstützung bei der Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und -konsistenz über FIM-, SCB- und Vulnerability-Management-Tools hinweg.

• Unterstützen Sie wiederkehrende operative Aufgaben wie: Berichterstellung, Statusprüfungen, Beweisextraktion, Nachverfolgung

• Diese Rolle ist nicht für Tool-Engineering, Regelentwicklung oder Architektur verantwortlich, erfordert jedoch ein solides Verständnis dafür, wie die Tools funktionieren und wie Ergebnisse interpretiert werden sollten.

• Audit- und Compliance-Unterstützung

• Unterstützen Sie aktiv interne und externe Prüfungsaktivitäten (z. B. FINMA, DORA, interne Prüfungen), indem Sie Prüfungsnachweise direkt aus Cyber Security Resilience-Tools extrahieren, um sicherzustellen, dass die Beweise vollständig, nachvollziehbar und auf Prüfungsanfragen abgestimmt sind, und um Antworten auf Prüfungsfragen in Abstimmung mit leitenden Teammitgliedern zu unterstützen.

• Pflegen Sie strukturierte Prüfungsnachweis-Repositorys und unterstützen Sie die kontinuierliche Prüfungsbereitschaft.

• Helfen Sie dabei, Prozesse zur Beweiserhebung zu standardisieren und zu rationalisieren, um die Arbeitsbelastung des gesamten Teams zu verringern.

• Koordination und Stakeholder-Unterstützung

• Zusammenarbeit mit Infrastruktur-, Plattform- und Betriebsteams bei betrieblichen Klärungen und Ticket-Nachverfolgungen.

• Unterstützen Sie das Cyber ​​Security Resilience-Team, indem Sie den Betriebsaufwand übernehmen und es Ingenieuren und Spezialisten ermöglichen, sich auf Analysen und Verbesserungsinitiativen zu konzentrieren.

• Leiten Sie betriebliche Risiken, wiederkehrende Probleme oder Datenlücken auf strukturierte Weise an leitende Teammitglieder weiter.

• Solides grundlegendes Verständnis von Cyber-Sicherheitskonzepten, insbesondere: Schwachstellenmanagement, sichere Systemkonfiguration / CIS-Benchmarks, Dateiintegrität und Änderungsüberwachung

• Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Sicherheits- oder Infrastrukturtools, idealerweise in einer operativen oder serviceorientierten Rolle.

• Vertrautheit mit Ticketsystemen, SLAs und Betriebsunterstützungsmodellen.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von Audits, Compliance-Aktivitäten oder der Sammlung von Beweismitteln ist von großem Vorteil.

• Strukturiert, detailorientiert und zuverlässig in der Ausführung.

• Komfortables Arbeiten mit Betriebsdaten, Beweisen und sich wiederholenden Aufgaben unter Beibehaltung der Qualität.

• Kann sowohl mit technischen als auch nichttechnischen Interessenvertretern klar kommunizieren.

• Proaktiv bei der Identifizierung von Ineffizienzen oder Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten in betrieblichen Prozessen.

• Fließende Englischkenntnisse

• Deutscher Vorteil

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste des opérations de résilience en cybersécurité

Varsovie | jusqu'à 40% travaillant à domicile | Référence 7950

The Cyber Security Resilience Operations Specialist supports the day-to-day operation of the Cyber Security Resilience services, with a strong focus on service desk activities, operational follow-up, and audit support.

The role acts as the first operational layer for File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB), and Vulnerability Management, relieving senior engineers and analysts from administrative, evidentiary, and coordination tasks while ensuring consistency, quality, and audit readiness.

Ce que vous ferez

• Support opérationnel et centre de services

• Act as the primary point of contact for service desk requests and tickets related to: File Integrity Monitoring (FIM), Secure Configuration Baseline (SCB / CIS Benchmarks), Vulnerability Management activities

• Trier, suivre et coordonner les tickets opérationnels, en garantissant un traitement rapide et une communication claire avec les parties prenantes.

• Perform initial analysis and validation of findings (e.g. expected vs. unexpected changes, status of vulnerabilities, baseline deviations) before escalation.

• Tenir à jour la documentation opérationnelle, les runbooks et les FAQ liés aux services de résilience en matière de cybersécurité.

• Activités opérationnelles basées sur des outils

• Operate and support Cyber Security Resilience tooling on a daily basis, including retrieving data, validating results, and supporting reporting activities.

• Assist in maintaining data quality and consistency across FIM, SCB, and Vulnerability Management tools.

• Support recurring operational tasks such as: Report generation, Status checks, Evidence extraction, Follow-up tracking

• Ce rôle n'est pas responsable de l'ingénierie des outils, du développement des règles ou de l'architecture, mais nécessite une solide compréhension du fonctionnement des outils et de la manière dont les résultats doivent être interprétés.

• Assistance en matière d'audit et de conformité

• Soutenir activement les activités d'audit interne et externe (par exemple FINMA, DORA, audits internes) en extrayant les preuves d'audit directement à partir des outils de résilience en matière de cybersécurité, en garantissant que les preuves sont complètes, traçables et alignées avec les demandes d'audit, en soutenant les réponses aux questions d'audit en coordination avec les membres supérieurs de l'équipe.

• Maintain structured audit evidence repositories and support continuous audit readiness.

• Help standardise and streamline evidence collection processes to reduce broader team workload.

• Coordination et soutien des parties prenantes

• Liaise with infrastructure, platform, and operations teams on operational clarifications and ticket follow-ups.

• Soutenir l'équipe de résilience de la cybersécurité en absorbant les frais généraux opérationnels, permettant ainsi aux ingénieurs et aux spécialistes de se concentrer sur les initiatives d'analyse et d'amélioration.

• Escalate operational risks, recurring issues, or data gaps to senior team members in a structured manner.

Ce que vous apportez

• Solide compréhension de base des concepts de cybersécurité, en particulier : gestion des vulnérabilités, configuration du système sécurisé / benchmarks CIS, intégrité des fichiers et surveillance des modifications.

• Hands-on experience working with security or infrastructure tooling, ideally in an operational or service-oriented role.

• Familiarity with ticketing systems, SLAs, and operational support models.

• Une expérience en matière d'audits, d'activités de conformité ou de collecte de preuves constitue un atout majeur.

• Structuré, soucieux du détail et fiable dans l'exécution.

• À l'aise de travailler avec des données opérationnelles, des preuves et des tâches répétitives tout en maintenant la qualité.

• Capable de communiquer clairement avec les parties prenantes techniques et non techniques.

• Proactif dans l'identification des inefficacités ou des opportunités d'amélioration dans les processus opérationnels.

• Maîtrise de l'anglais

• Avantage allemand

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au .

Pour ce poste vacant, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des candidatures indépendamment de toute expérience personnelle.

Site Reliability Engineer

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8133

We’re looking for a seasoned DevOps/SRE professional to drive automation, reliability, and operational excellence across our platforms. You will own CI/CD pipelines, release processes, incident response, and collaborate closely with development and infrastructure teams to ensure smooth, secure, and scalable delivery.

What You Will Do

• Prioritize automation over manual work; eliminate toil through tooling and process improvements.

• Collaborate with development and infrastructure teams to streamline delivery.

• Own release management and deployment processes.

• Design, build, and maintain team CI/CD pipelines.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues.

• Participate in Scrum ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement.

• 2nd-Level Support; handle incidents and problem management, participate in on-call rotations and respond to high-priority events.

• Dispatching and Coordination; prioritize and route tasks effectively, communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders.

• Ownership and Seniority; bring seasoned expertise and technical judgment, take ownership of critical tasks and projects end-to-end.

What You Bring

• Degree in Computer Science or a related field, plus 5+ years in DevOps/SRE (ideally in containerized environments).

• Deep experience with Linux and containers (Docker, Podman, OpenShift/Kubernetes).

• Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and tooling.

• Excellent problem-solving, prioritization, and ability to work independently.

• Strong work ethic and collaborative mindset.

• Excellent verbal and written English.

• CI/CD: GitLab CI, Ansible (experience building pipelines and automation), ArgoCD, Helm.

• Languages/Scripting: Java or C++, Python, Bash.

• Streaming/Data: Kafka (thorough knowledge).

• Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, ELK,

• Databases/Directory: LDAP/OUD, MySQL.

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

IT Product Manager

Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8015

Are you passionate about IT technologies and interested in working in a highly dynamic environment? Join the Costs & Vendors team, where you will help manage costs and compliance for our global IT infrastructure and workplace. You will collaborate with internal and external partners to deliver services for the global IT of SIX.

What You Will Do

• Support the financial steering of global IT infrastructure products (budget planning, forecasting, cost transparency)

• Act as a single point of contact for internal stakeholders and coordinate IT procurement requests and clarifications

• Support contract and license management activities (renewal tracking, documentation, basic compliance checks)

• Prepare reports and maintain operational processes (purchase orders, demand verification, renewals, documentation)

What You Bring

• First experience in IT product management, service-, contract- or license management

• Basic financial understanding (budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation) and strong attention to detail

• Strong analytical skills and interest in IT infrastructure and how services are delivered

• Willingness to learn licensing models and understand their commercial impact

• Skilled in Power BI reporting, automation and the use of artificial intelligence

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German and/or Spanish are a plus

• Growth mindset, open to change, and motivated to take on more responsibility step-by-step

jobs.title: Analytics & Technology Specialist (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Analytics & Technology Specialist (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8250

Do you want to help shape the future of market surveillance through advanced analytics, technology and data-driven decision making?

Surveillance Assurance & Development (SAD) is responsible for the continuous enhancement of surveillance capabilities supporting SIX Exchange Regulation's mission to detect market abuse and rule violations, including insider trading, market and price manipulation. SAD acts as the bridge between market surveillance, business stakeholders and IT, driving the evolution of surveillance systems, analytical models and technologies while ensuring their effectiveness and quality.

As an Analytics & Technology Specialist, you will play a key role in developing and improving surveillance methodologies, alert logic and analytical solutions. You will work closely with Markets Supervision & Investigations (MSI) and IT to assess new opportunities, evaluate the effectiveness of existing controls and identify innovative approaches to strengthen market surveillance.

The role combines advanced analytics, statistics, surveillance expertise and technology. You will contribute to the design and evolution of surveillance scenarios, assess the impact of new requirements, and leverage advanced analytics, statistical methods, artificial intelligence and data science techniques to enhance surveillance effectiveness. At the same time, you will help ensure continuity of key surveillance solutions while supporting the ongoing transformation towards a cloud-based technology landscape.

What You Will Do

• Ensure continuity of selected surveillance solutions, data assets and technical processes currently maintained by the departing Data Engineer, while supporting the gradual transition of some responsibilities to IT.

• Analyse, review and enhance market surveillance alerts, detection methodologies, scenarios, parameters and thresholds, applying advanced analytics, statistical methods and AI/ML techniques to improve surveillance effectiveness.

• Assess the impact of new features, business requirements and regulatory changes on surveillance processes and systems, and identify required enhancements.

• Evaluate new surveillance approaches, anomaly detection techniques and emerging technologies, contributing to the evolution of market surveillance capabilities.

• Translate surveillance and business requirements into technical specifications and implementation concepts, and collaborate closely with business and IT teams throughout design, testing and implementation.

What You Bring

• University degree in Finance, Economics, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience with statistical analysis, anomaly detection and model evaluation, combined with the ability to assess and improve analytical models, alert calibration and detection methodologies.

• Strong SQL and Python skills and experience analysing large datasets, ideally using modern analytics platforms such as Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark. Knowledge of AI-assisted analytics tools and techniques is considered an advantage.

• Experience in financial markets, market surveillance or transaction reporting is considered a strong asset.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and IT functions.

• Fluent in English (both verbal & writing), German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Vuoi contribuire a plasmare il futuro della sorveglianza del mercato attraverso analisi avanzate, tecnologia e processi decisionali basati sui dati?

Surveillance Assurance & Development (SAD) è responsabile del continuo miglioramento delle capacità di sorveglianza che supportano la missione di SIX Exchange Regulation di rilevare abusi di mercato e violazioni delle regole, tra cui insider trading, market e manipolazione dei prezzi. SAD funge da ponte tra sorveglianza del mercato, stakeholder aziendali e IT, guidando l'evoluzione dei sistemi di sorveglianza, modelli analitici e tecnologie, garantendo al contempo la loro efficacia e qualità.

In qualità di Analytics & Technology Specialist, svolgerai un ruolo chiave nello sviluppo e nel miglioramento delle metodologie di sorveglianza, della logica di allerta e delle soluzioni analitiche. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con Markets Supervision & Investigations (MSI) e IT per valutare nuove opportunità, valutare l'efficacia dei controlli esistenti e identificare approcci innovativi per rafforzare la sorveglianza del mercato.

Il ruolo combina analisi avanzate, statistiche, competenze di sorveglianza e tecnologia. Contribuirai alla progettazione e all'evoluzione degli scenari di sorveglianza, valuterai l'impatto dei nuovi requisiti, e leverai analisi avanzate, metodi statistici, intelligenza artificiale e tecniche di scienza dei dati per migliorare l'efficacia della sorveglianza. Allo stesso tempo, vi aiuterà a garantire la continuità delle soluzioni di sorveglianza chiave, supportando la continua trasformazione verso un paesaggio tecnologico basato su cloud.

Cosa farai

• Assicurare la continuità di soluzioni di sorveglianza selezionate, risorse di dati e processi tecnici attualmente mantenuti dal Data Engineer in partenza, supportando al contempo la graduale transizione di alcune responsabilità verso l'IT.

• Analizzare, rivedere e migliorare gli avvisi di sorveglianza del mercato, metodologie di rilevamento, scenari, parametri e soglie, applicando analisi avanzate, metodi statistici e tecniche AI/ML per migliorare l'efficacia della sorveglianza.

• Valuta l'impatto di nuove funzionalità, requisiti aziendali e cambiamenti normativi sui processi e sistemi di sorveglianza e identifica i miglioramenti richiesti.

• Valutare nuovi approcci di sorveglianza, tecniche di rilevamento delle anomalie e tecnologie emergenti, contribuendo all'evoluzione delle capacità di sorveglianza del mercato.

• Tradurre i requisiti di sorveglianza e di business in specifiche tecniche e concetti di implementazione, e collaborare a stretto contatto con i team aziendali e IT durante la progettazione, test e implementazione.

Che cosa porta

• Laurea in Finanza, Economia, Scienza dei dati, Statistica, Scienza informatica o un campo correlato.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di problem solving, tra cui l'esperienza con analisi statistiche, rilevamento di anomalia e valutazione del modello, combinato con la capacità di valutare e migliorare i modelli analitici, la calibrazione dell'avviso e le metodologie di rilevamento.

• Forte capacità SQL e Python e esperienza analizzando grandi dataset, idealmente utilizzando piattaforme di analisi moderne come Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark. La conoscenza di strumenti e tecniche di analisi assistiti da AI è considerata un vantaggio.

• L'esperienza nei mercati finanziari, la sorveglianza del mercato o il reporting delle transazioni è considerata un bene forte.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder con la capacità di collaborare efficacemente attraverso le funzioni aziendali e IT.

• Fluente in inglese (sia verbale che scritta), tedesco è un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Julia Schmidt al numero +41583998670 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste en analyse et technologie (80 - 100%)

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8250

Voulez-vous aider à façonner l'avenir de la surveillance du marché par l'analyse avancée, la technologie et la prise de décision axée sur les données?

Surveillance Assurance & Développement (SAD) est responsable de l'amélioration continue des capacités de surveillance appuyant la mission de SIX Exchange Regulation de détecter les abus de marché et les violations des règles, y compris le trading d'initiés, la manipulation du marché et des prix. La SAD sert de pont entre la surveillance du marché, les acteurs commerciaux et l'informatique, en dirigeant l'évolution des systèmes de surveillance, des modèles analytiques et des technologies tout en assurant leur efficacité et leur qualité.

En tant que spécialiste en analyse et technologie, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement et l'amélioration des méthodologies de surveillance, de la logique d'alerte et des solutions analytiques. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec Markets Supervision & Investigations (MSI) et IT pour évaluer les nouvelles possibilités, évaluer l'efficacité des contrôles existants et identifier des approches novatrices pour renforcer la surveillance du marché.

Ce rôle combine l'analyse avancée, les statistiques, l'expertise en surveillance et la technologie. Vous contribuerez à la conception et à l'évolution des scénarios de surveillance, évaluerez l'impact des nouvelles exigences et tirerez parti des techniques avancées d'analyse, de méthodes statistiques, d'intelligence artificielle et de science des données pour améliorer l'efficacité de la surveillance. En même temps, vous aiderez à assurer la continuité des solutions de surveillance clés tout en soutenant la transformation continue vers un paysage technologique basé sur le cloud.

Ce que vous ferez

• Assurer la continuité de certaines solutions de surveillance, d'actifs de données et de processus techniques actuellement maintenus par l'ingénieur de données sortant, tout en appuyant la transition progressive de certaines responsabilités à la TI.

• Analyser, examiner et améliorer les alertes de surveillance du marché, les méthodes de détection, les scénarios, les paramètres et les seuils, en appliquant des analyses avancées, des méthodes statistiques et des techniques d'IA/ML pour améliorer l'efficacité de la surveillance.

• Évaluer l'incidence des nouvelles caractéristiques, des exigences opérationnelles et des changements réglementaires sur les processus et les systèmes de surveillance et déterminer les améliorations requises.

• Évaluer les nouvelles approches de surveillance, les techniques de détection des anomalies et les technologies émergentes, contribuant à l'évolution des capacités de surveillance du marché.

• Traduire la surveillance et les exigences opérationnelles en spécifications techniques et concepts de mise en œuvre, et collaborer étroitement avec les équipes d'affaires et de TI tout au long de la conception, des essais et de la mise en œuvre.

Ce que vous apportez

• Diplôme universitaire en finance, économie, science des données, statistique, informatique ou un domaine connexe.

• De solides compétences en analyse et en résolution de problèmes, y compris l'expérience en analyse statistique, en détection des anomalies et en évaluation des modèles, ainsi que la capacité d'évaluer et d'améliorer les modèles analytiques, les méthodes d'étalonnage et de détection des alertes.

• Fortes compétences SQL et Python et expérience d'analyse de gros ensembles de données, idéalement en utilisant des plates-formes analytiques modernes telles que Azure, Databricks, Spark/PySpark. La connaissance des outils et des techniques d'analyse assistée par l'IA est considérée comme un avantage.

• L'expérience des marchés financiers, de la surveillance des marchés ou de la déclaration des transactions est considérée comme un actif solide.

• Fortes compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants avec la capacité de collaborer efficacement à l'ensemble des fonctions d'affaires et de TI.

• Fluent en anglais ( verbale et écrite), l'allemand est un plus.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Julia Schmidt au +41583998670 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Developer Platform Engineer (Windows/Linux)
jobs.description:
SIX impulsa la transformación de los mercados financieros.

Lo que nos hace diferente, nos impulsa a avanzar: entre raíces locales y relevancia global, somos una mezcla única de tradición y futuro, de cimientos y crecimiento. Apreciamos el valor de mentes brillantes y las inspiramos a crecer con sus ideas. Da forma al futuro de las finanzas con nosotros.

Developer Platform Engineer (Windows/Linux)

Madrid, Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Referencia  8031

We are seeking a Developer Experience Engineer to join our centralized DevOps Tools Team. As a Developer Experience Engineer, you define and configure development environments that software engineers rely on every day. You focus on creating reliable, secure, and consistent developer profiles including IDEs to command‑line tooling and possible CI/CD integration.

Working closely with platform, security, and product engineering teams, you continuously improve the developer experience by reducing friction, increasing automation, and enabling engineers to focus on building high‑quality software.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain developer client tools such as CLIs, IDE configurations and local development environments.

• Standardize and automate developer onboarding and local setup across Linux and Windows.

• Integrate client tools with source control, CI/CD pipelines, artifact repositories and package managers.

• Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure secure, policy‑compliant developer environments.

• Act as a technical point of contact for engineering teams, gathering feedback and translating it into tooling and end-to-end developer workflow improvements.

• Document tools, workflows, and best practices to enable self‑service and adoption at scale.

What You Bring

• A strong background in software engineering, DevOps, Docker, platform engineering or developer productivity.

• Solid programming skills in at least one language such as Python, Bash, Powershell or TypeScript.

• Experience working with CI/CD systems and integrating local tooling with build and release pipelines.

• Hands‑on experience with build tools and dependency management, Package managers (e.g. npm, pip, Maven), Linux and Windows environments (preferred).

• A strong focus on developer experience, usability and automation.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to document and explain technical solutions.

If you have any questions,  check out our  FAQ page  or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Head Relationship Management, UK / EU

titleByLocale.it: Gestione delle relazioni principali, Regno Unito / UE
titleByLocale.fr: Gestion des relations avec les dirigeants, Royaume-Uni / UE

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Relationship Management, UK / EU

London |  Hybrid 80-100% | Reference 8232

At SIX, we are at the heart of the financial ecosystem, providing critical infrastructure and services that enable the smooth functioning of global capital markets. As Head of Relationship Management, you will play a pivotal role in strengthening and expanding our strategic partnerships with banks, broker-dealers and other financial institutions across the Securities Services value chain.

As a team lead you will drive client engagement, identify growth opportunities and ensure clients maximise the value of SIX's post-trade solutions, including Clearing, Custody & Asset Servicing, Securities Finance and Trade Repositories. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Operations, Risk and Compliance, you will shape client strategies, influence business development initiatives and represent SIX as a senior ambassador in the financial market.

This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded leader with deep post-trade expertise who is passionate about delivering exceptional client experiences, fostering high-performing teams and contributing to the continued growth and success of SIX's international business.

What You Will Do

•    Ensure that strategic relationships with banks and broker/dealers are established and further developed at the respective levels in order to grow the business across the various business lines.
•    Identify and execute cross-selling and upselling opportunities, in close collaboration with your team and the dedicated sales colleagues, across the value chain, ensuring clients benefit from the full suite of services.
•    Work closely with cross-functional teams such as Sales, Product & Business Development, Operations, Risk and Compliance identifying and addressing clients’ needs and opportunities, to incorporate new solutions and mandates.
•    Collaborate with other business units referring x-sell opportunities.
•    Articulate and actively manage individual client account business plans, set targets, internal reporting and to ad-hoc inquiries.
•    Representation of SIX in the financial market as senior representative (networking events, forums, etc.).

What You Bring

•    A minimum of 10 years of experience in a Post-Trade relationship management role within the financial industry (B2B).
•    Experience as a team lead is preferable.
•    Solid understanding of our core business and respective market and client requirements.
•    Structured and thorough approach to lead/guide a team and interact with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.
•    High level of customer orientation, communication and interpersonal skills.
•    Excellent organizational, reporting and presentation skills.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Gestione delle relazioni principali, Regno Unito / UE

Londra | Hybrid 80-100% | Riferimento 8232

A SIX, siamo al centro dell'ecosistema finanziario, fornendo infrastrutture e servizi critici che consentono il buon funzionamento dei mercati dei capitali globali. In qualità di responsabile della gestione delle relazioni, svolgerai un ruolo fondamentale nel rafforzamento e nell'espansione delle nostre partnership strategiche con banche, broker-dealers e altre istituzioni finanziarie nella catena del valore di Securities Services.

Come team leader, guiderai l'impegno del cliente, identificherai le opportunità di crescita e garantirai ai clienti di massimizzare il valore delle soluzioni post-commerciali di SIX, tra cui Clearing, Custody & Asset Servicing, Securities Finance e Trade Repositories. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i colleghi di Sales, Product, Operations, Risk e Compliance, formerai strategie client, influenzerai le iniziative di sviluppo aziendale e rappresenterai SIX come ambasciatore senior nel mercato finanziario.

Si tratta di un'emozionante opportunità per un leader di mentalità commerciale con una profonda esperienza post-commerciale che si appassiona a offrire esperienze clienti eccezionali, a promuovere team di alto livello e contribuire alla continua crescita e successo del business internazionale di SIX.

Cosa farai

• Assicurarsi che i rapporti strategici con banche e broker/dealers siano stabiliti e ulteriormente sviluppati ai rispettivi livelli al fine di far crescere il business attraverso le varie linee aziendali.
• Identificare ed eseguire opportunità di cross-selling e upselling, in stretta collaborazione con il vostro team e i colleghi di vendita dedicati, attraverso la catena del valore, garantendo ai clienti di beneficiare della suite completa di servizi.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali come Sales, Product & Business Development, Operations, Risk and Compliance che identificano e affrontano le esigenze e le opportunità dei clienti, per incorporare nuove soluzioni e mandati.
• Collabora con altri business unit che riferiscono le opportunità di vendita x.
• Articolare e gestire attivamente i piani aziendali individuali del cliente, impostare obiettivi, report interni e le richieste ad-hoc.
• Rappresentanza di SIX nel mercato finanziario come rappresentante senior (eventi di rete, forum, ecc.).

Che cosa porta

• Un minimo di 10 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di gestione delle relazioni Post-Trade nell'industria finanziaria (B2B).
• L'esperienza come team lead è preferibile.
• Solida comprensione del nostro core business e dei rispettivi requisiti di mercato e cliente.
• Approccio strutturato e approfondito per guidare / guidare un team e interagire con una vasta gamma di stakeholder interni ed esterni.
• Alto livello di orientamento del cliente, comunicazione e competenze interpersonali.
• Eccellente capacità organizzative, di reportistica e di presentazione.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.
