Consulente senior in materia di governance aziendale

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8090

Siamo alla ricerca di un consulente in materia di governance aziendale per contribuire a rafforzare la governance aziendale in tutto il Gruppo. Il ruolo è di anzianità di livello medio, con spazio per l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo.

In questo ruolo, lavorerai a stretto contatto con il responsabile della governance legale e i team di governance in Svizzera e Spagna. Aiuterai a definire gli standard di governance, supportare la gestione delle entità legali e migliorare i processi di governance chiave in un gruppo internazionale.

Non vediamo l'ora di sentire la tua opinione. Non esitare e candidati ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Assistere il Segretario Societario e l'Assistente Segretario Societario nella programmazione, preparazione e svolgimento delle riunioni del Consiglio di Amministrazione, predisporre i verbali, gestire la condivisione delle informazioni secondo le prassi e regolamenti interni, gestire le formalità di segreteria (notaio, archiviazione, registri ecc.).

• Fornire consulenza sulla governance relativa alla governance delle entità giuridiche, comprese le entità di nuova costituzione, le entità acquisite, le cessioni, le joint venture e nel contesto di riorganizzazioni e assistere nella revisione dei documenti di governance, inclusi lo statuto, le regole organizzative e le regole di competenza.

• Fornire consulenza sull'autorità di firma e supportare lo sviluppo delle politiche e dei processi correlati.

• Creare e gestire modelli per la documentazione relativa alla governance e migliorare i principali flussi di lavoro di governance, nonché supportare e promuovere progetti di governance e miglioramenti dei processi basati sull'intelligenza artificiale.

• Mantenere la gestione dei documenti e le strutture di SharePoint e garantire un'adeguata archiviazione e redigere note legali, preparare presentazioni e offrire formazione alle parti interessate interne. Redazione di procure e supporto dei processi notarili e di registrazione.

• Collaborare con i colleghi di tutte le funzioni e giurisdizioni per fornire soluzioni pratiche di governance e assistere nella definizione di standard e processi per garantire una governance coordinata ed efficiente di tutte le entità legali all'interno del Gruppo.

• Partecipare all'esecuzione di progetti strategici in quanto riguardano le entità legali e la governance.

Cosa porti

• Un minimo di 5 anni di esperienza nella governance aziendale in Spagna.

• Esperienza nella definizione di standard e processi in un gruppo di entità giuridiche costituite in diverse giurisdizioni.

• Scrivi in ​​modo chiaro, lavori in modo strutturato e trasformi argomenti complessi in soluzioni pratiche.

• Personalità da giocatore di squadra con forti capacità di collaborazione, un occhio per i dettagli e pragmatismo. Apprezzi la semplicità rispetto alla complessità. Puoi fare affidamento sulla tua discrezione ed efficienza. Sei desideroso di apprendere e sviluppare continuamente e accogli feedback e guida.

• Hai dimestichezza con Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint e Word e ti senti a tuo agio nel lavorare con gli strumenti di intelligenza artificiale.

• Parli fluentemente inglese e spagnolo.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina delle FAQ o chiama Sara Perez de la Cuesta al +34 91 709 56 80 .

Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo candidature dirette in inglese.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, cerchiamo di ricevere candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - est le moteur de la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième plus grand groupe boursier d'Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous fait avancer : entre racines locales et importance mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d’avenir, de fondation et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les incitons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l’avenir de la finance avec nous.

Conseiller principal en gouvernance d'entreprise

Madrid | Travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% | Référence 8090

Nous recherchons un Corporate Governance Counsel pour contribuer à renforcer la gouvernance d’entreprise à travers le Groupe. Le rôle est d'une ancienneté de niveau intermédiaire, avec une marge d'apprentissage et de développement.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le responsable de la gouvernance juridique et les équipes de gouvernance en Suisse et en Espagne. Vous contribuerez à façonner les normes de gouvernance, à soutenir la gestion des entités juridiques et à améliorer les processus de gouvernance clés au sein d'un groupe international.

Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. N'hésitez plus et postulez dès maintenant avec votre CV en anglais.

Ce que vous ferez

• Assister le Secrétaire Général et le Secrétaire Général Adjoint dans la programmation, la préparation et le déroulement des réunions du Conseil d'Administration, préparer les procès-verbaux, gérer le partage d'informations selon les usages et règlements internes, gérer les formalités de secrétariat (notaire, dépôt, registres etc.).

• Fournir des conseils en matière de gouvernance concernant la gouvernance des entités juridiques, y compris les entités nouvellement créées, les entités acquises, les cessions, les coentreprises et dans le contexte de réorganisations et aider à l'examen des documents de gouvernance, y compris les statuts, les règles d'organisation et les règles de compétence.

• Conseiller sur l'autorité de signature et soutenir l'élaboration de politiques et de processus connexes.

• Créer et maintenir des modèles pour la documentation relative à la gouvernance, améliorer les flux de travail de gouvernance clés, soutenir et piloter les projets de gouvernance et les améliorations des processus basés sur l'IA.

• Maintenir la gestion des documents et les structures SharePoint et assurer un archivage approprié et rédiger des notes juridiques, préparer des présentations et dispenser des formations aux parties prenantes internes. Rédiger les procurations et accompagner les démarches notariales et d’enregistrement.

• Travailler avec des collègues de toutes les fonctions et juridictions pour fournir des solutions de gouvernance pratiques et aider à l'établissement de normes et de processus pour garantir une gouvernance coordonnée et efficace de toutes les entités juridiques au sein du Groupe.

• Participer à l'exécution de projets stratégiques liés aux entités juridiques et à la gouvernance.

Ce que vous apportez

• Un minimum de 5 ans d'expérience en gouvernance d'entreprise en Espagne.

• Expérience dans l'établissement de normes et de processus au sein d'un groupe d'entités juridiques constituées dans différentes juridictions.

• Vous écrivez clairement, travaillez de manière structurée et transformez des sujets complexes en solutions pratiques.

• Personnalité d'esprit d'équipe avec de fortes compétences collaboratives, un sens du détail et du pragmatisme. Vous privilégiez la simplicité à la complexité. On peut compter sur vous pour votre discrétion et votre efficacité. Vous êtes désireux d’apprendre et de vous développer continuellement et vous acceptez les commentaires et les conseils.

• Vous maîtrisez Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint et Word et êtes à l'aise avec les outils d'IA.

• Vous parlez couramment l'anglais et l'espagnol.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 .

Pour ce poste vacant, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des candidatures indépendamment de toute expérience personnelle.

jobs.title: Data Licensing Specialist (Finance & Process Automation)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Data Licensing Specialist (Finance & Process Automation)

London |  60% office requirement and 40% hybrid | Reference 8209

Are you looking to grow your career in a dynamic, collaborative environment? We are seeking a Data Licensing Specialist for Finance & Process Automation to join our London-based Data Licensing Managment team, with responsibility for financial tasks, operational compliance and quality assurance.

You will work with minimal supervision and manage a varied workload. The role involves supporting Customers, Data Suppliers, Sales, Data Acquisition and the wider Customer Operations team, while working closely with Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Controlling. You will manage external relationships on financial matters, support issue resolution, and play an active role in process improvement, automation initiatives and the adoption of AI-enabled solutions across operational activities. The role offers the opportunity to combine financial process ownership with innovation, helping to improve efficiency, scalability and service quality within Customer Operations and Data Licensing Management. Accuracy, attention to detail, a collaborative mindset and a genuine interest in continuous improvement are essential.

What You Will Do

• Maintain and enrich critical reference and master data across financial information services, ensuring high levels of accuracy, completeness, and integrity.

• Perform sanctions screening and security master data controls in line with regulatory, compliance, and risk management requirements.

• Monitor data quality, investigate discrepancies, and resolve exceptions to support operational excellence and client satisfaction.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Operations, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to improve data processes and controls.

• Contribute to process optimization, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement activities within Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services.

What You will Bring

• Experience in operations, data management, business process outsourcing, financial services, or a related environment.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to analyze, validate, and maintain large volumes of sensitive data accurately.

• Knowledge of sanctions screening, regulatory requirements, KYC/AML principles, or financial market infrastructure is advantageous.

• Excellent problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to investigating and resolving operational issues.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Anthony Mills  at +44 207 550 5407 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Data Licensing Specialist (Finance & Process Automation)

Londra | 60% richiesta di ufficio e 40% ibrido | Riferimento 8209

Stai cercando di crescere la tua carriera in un ambiente dinamico e collaborativo? Stiamo cercando un Data Licensing Specialist for Finance & Process Automation per unire il nostro team di Gestione licenze dati di Londra, con responsabilità per compiti finanziari, conformità operativa e garanzia di qualità.

Potrai lavorare con una supervisione minima e gestire un carico di lavoro vario. Il ruolo consiste nel supportare clienti, fornitori di dati, vendite, acquisizione dati e il più ampio team di operazioni dei clienti, mentre si sta lavorando a stretto contatto con Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable e Controlling. Potrai gestire relazioni esterne su questioni finanziarie, risoluzione dei problemi di supporto e svolgere un ruolo attivo nel miglioramento dei processi, iniziative di automazione e l'adozione di soluzioni abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale in tutte le attività operative. Il ruolo offre l'opportunità di combinare la proprietà dei processi finanziari con l'innovazione, contribuendo a migliorare l'efficienza, la scalabilità e la qualità dei servizi all'interno delle operazioni dei clienti e della gestione dei dati. L'accuratezza, l'attenzione ai dettagli, una mentalità collaborativa e un autentico interesse per il miglioramento continuo sono essenziali.

Cosa farai

• Mantenere e arricchire i dati critici di riferimento e master attraverso i servizi di informazione finanziaria, garantendo elevati livelli di accuratezza, completezza e integrità.

• Eseguire i controlli dei dati di screening e di controllo dei dati di controllo della sicurezza in linea con i requisiti di regolazione, conformità e gestione dei rischi.

• Monitorare la qualità dei dati, indagare le discrepanze e risolvere le eccezioni per supportare l'eccellenza operativa e la soddisfazione del cliente.

• Collabora con gli stakeholder interni tra i team Operations, Compliance, Product e Technology per migliorare i processi e i controlli dei dati.

• Contribuire a processi di ottimizzazione, iniziative di automazione e attività di miglioramento continuo all'interno dei servizi di Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).

Cosa porterai

• Esperienza in operazioni, gestione dei dati, outsourcing dei processi aziendali, servizi finanziari o un ambiente correlato.

• Forte attenzione ai dettagli con la capacità di analizzare, convalidare e mantenere con precisione grandi volumi di dati sensibili.

• La conoscenza delle sanzioni screening, requisiti normativi, principi KYC/AML, o infrastrutture di mercato finanziario è vantaggioso.

• Eccellente capacità di problem solving con un approccio proattivo per indagare e risolvere problemi operativi.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e gestione degli stakeholder, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Anthony Mills al numero +44 207 550 5407 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Genauigkeit, Liebe zum Detail, eine kollaborative Denkweise und ein echtes Interesse an kontinuierlicher Verbesserung sind unerlässlich.

• Pflegen und Anreichern von kritischen Referenz- und Stammdaten über Finanzinformationsdienste hinweg, um ein hohes Maß an Genauigkeit, Vollständigkeit und Integrität zu gewährleisten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit internen Stakeholdern in den Teams für Betrieb, Compliance, Produkt und Technologie zusammen, um Datenprozesse und -kontrollen zu verbessern.

• Beitrag zu Prozessoptimierung, Automatisierungsinitiativen und kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsaktivitäten im Rahmen von Business Process Outsourcing (BPO).

• Erfahrung in Betrieb, Datenmanagement, Geschäftsprozess-Outsourcing, Finanzdienstleistungen oder einer verwandten Umgebung.

• Starke Liebe zum Detail mit der Fähigkeit, große Mengen sensibler Daten genau zu analysieren, zu validieren und zu pflegen.

• Die Kenntnis von Sanktionen, regulatorischen Anforderungen, KYC / AML-Prinzipien oder der Finanzmarktinfrastruktur ist von Vorteil.

• Hervorragende Fähigkeiten zur Problemlösung mit einem proaktiven Ansatz zur Untersuchung und Lösung operativer Probleme.

• Starke Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umgebung effektiv zu arbeiten.

Vous travaillerez avec une supervision minimale et gérerez une charge de travail variée. Le rôle consiste à soutenir les clients, les fournisseurs de données, les ventes, l'acquisition de données et l'ensemble de l'équipe des opérations client, tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les comptes débiteurs, les comptes créditeurs et le contrôle. Vous gérerez les relations externes sur les questions financières, soutienrez la résolution des problèmes et jouerez un rôle actif dans l'amélioration des processus, les initiatives d'automatisation et l'adoption de solutions adaptées à l'IA dans toutes les activités opérationnelles. Ce rôle offre la possibilité de combiner l'appropriation des processus financiers et l'innovation, contribuant ainsi à améliorer l'efficacité, l'évolutivité et la qualité du service au sein des opérations clientes et de la gestion des licences de données. L'exactitude, l'attention aux détails, la collaboration et un véritable intérêt pour l'amélioration continue sont essentiels.

Ce que vous ferez

• Tenir à jour et enrichir les références critiques et les données maîtresses des services d'information financière, en assurant des niveaux élevés d'exactitude, d'exhaustivité et d'intégrité.

• Effectuer des contrôles de sécurité et de contrôle des données de base conformément aux exigences réglementaires, de conformité et de gestion des risques.

• Surveiller la qualité des données, étudier les écarts et résoudre les exceptions pour appuyer l'excellence opérationnelle et la satisfaction des clients.

• Collaborer avec les intervenants internes des équipes Opérations, Conformité, Produits et Technologie pour améliorer les processus et contrôles de données.

• Contribuer à l'optimisation des processus, aux initiatives d'automatisation et aux activités d'amélioration continue dans le cadre des services d'externalisation des processus opérationnels.

Ce que vous apporterez

• Expérience des opérations, de la gestion des données, de l'externalisation des processus opérationnels, des services financiers ou d'un environnement connexe.

• Une grande attention aux détails avec la capacité d'analyser, de valider et de maintenir de grands volumes de données sensibles avec précision.

• La connaissance du dépistage des sanctions, des exigences réglementaires, des principes KYC/AML ou de l'infrastructure des marchés financiers est avantageuse.

• Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes avec une approche proactive pour enquêter et résoudre les problèmes opérationnels.

• Des compétences solides en communication et en gestion des intervenants, avec la capacité de travailler efficacement dans un environnement de collaboration rapide.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior IT Project Manager

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8154

Are you passionate about steering enterprise-wide IT initiatives across their full lifecycle—reducing complexity, increasing resilience, and delivering measurable business value? We are seeking a Senior IT Project Manager for our Corporate Function IT (CIT) to lead international, cross-functional projects in infrastructure , operations , compliance, and security in an international team. You will drive migrations, modernizations, and harmonization programs, establish robust governance, and help the organization sustainably adopt standards and new solutions.

What You Will Do

• lead and deliver complex end-to-end IT projects across infrastructure, operations, compliance, and security in regulated environments

• plan and execute migrations, decommissioning, and cutovers, ensuring data integrity, integrations, and risk control

• establish and enforce governance, audit, and security standards; provide transparent steering and management reporting

• drive stakeholder engagement, change management, training, and communication to enable adoption and standardization

• coordinate cross-functional teams and vendors; prepare decision papers and materials for boards and committees

What You Bring

• 10+ years of IT project management experience (ideally in financial or other regulated environments) with proven delivery in infrastructure, compliance, and operations

• certifications in PRINCE2, PMP, IPMA or equivalent; strong, pragmatic use of agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) in hybrid setups

• proficiency with Jira/Confluence, Jira Service Management, Office 365, Planisware, and risk management tools; familiarity with BMC ITSM Suite, Enterprise Architect, access management, and firewall/network tools

• excellent analytical and conceptual skills with structured problem-solving, clear communication, and strong stakeholder/change management; high initiative, organization, and assertiveness with empathy and EQ

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa at +48 538 562 645

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Marketing Automation Manager

Madrid, Warsaw |  Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8067

Are you passionate about building marketing automation at an enterprise level and driving measurable business impact? Do you thrive in an international environment and enjoy shaping strategy, customer journeys, and data-driven decisions? Then join our international Digital team as Senior Marketing Automation Specialist.

In this role, you will own and further develop our business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, with a strong focus on generating Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs) and supporting sales opportunity creation. You will define and optimize lifecycle communications across email and other relevant channels.

You will act as the strategic driver behind targeting, segmentation, personalization, lifecycle design, attribution, and performance measurement. In doing so, you will define business requirements and work closely with IT, Data teams, and the Marketo Application Manager.

With your deep expertise in Marketing Automation, you will also steer and mentor a Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

We invest in the development of our experts and support you in continuously expanding your skills, both strategically and technically.

As a modern, innovative company at the intersection of technology and finance, SIX offers a wide range of opportunities to make a meaningful impact and fully leverage your potential.
We look forward to receiving your application in English.

What You Will Do

• Define and own the end-to-end business Marketing Automation strategy in Marketo, translating business objectives into clear automation use cases, roadmaps and success metrics, while aligning with platform capabilities.

• Define and optimize B2B email marketing and omnichannel engagement strategies, ensuring that nurturing, lifecycle communications, and automated journeys are relevant and aligned with business objectives across the customer journey.

• Design, implement, and optimize marketing automation frameworks (lead scoring, lead qualification, nurturing) and continuously improve targeting, segmentation, and personalization to drive Sales Qualified Leads (SQLs).

• Define and manage attribution models in Marketo, and contribute to holistic performance reporting by connecting Marketo data with Google Data Studio dashboards.

• Act as strategic owner and senior stakeholder interface for Marketing Automation, leading governance across internal teams (Compliance, Marketing, Sales, Tech, Data, IT) and external partners, while steering and and coaching one Junior Marketing Automation Manager.

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication, Marketing, Media, Public Relations, or a comparable field.

• 5+ years of experience in Marketing Automation, with proven ownership of enterprise‑scale Marketo setups and the ability to define and drive marketing automation strategy beyond campaign execution.

Data Transformation Specialist

Warsaw | Up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 8175

We are looking for a Data Transformation Specialist to drive process transformation and automation initiatives within Financial Information Data Operations. This role combines deep business knowledge of financial instrument data with strong technical capabilities to identify inefficiencies, redesign processes, and implement scalable automation solutions.

The successful candidate will work closely with stakeholders across Switzerland, Spain, the UK, and Poland, contributing directly to strategic transformation objectives and operational excellence initiatives.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining technology, data, and business process improvement to deliver measurable business impact.

What You Will Do

• Analyze existing business and data processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization.

• Design and implement future-state solutions that improve efficiency, scalability, and data quality.

• Translate business requirements into practical technical solutions.

• Drive transformation initiatives related to financial instrument data, reference data, corporate actions, and structured products.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders across multiple locations.

• Challenge existing processes and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.

• Support change management activities to ensure successful adoption of new solutions.

• Establish controls and monitoring mechanisms to maintain data quality and operational excellence.

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Spezialist für Datentransformation

Warschau | Bis zu 40% von zu Hause aus arbeiten möglich | Referenz 8175

Wir suchen einen Datentransformationsspezialisten, der Prozesstransformations- und Automatisierungsinitiativen im Bereich Financial Information Data Operations vorantreibt. Diese Rolle kombiniert fundiertes betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen über Finanzinstrumentdaten mit starken technischen Fähigkeiten, um Ineffizienzen zu erkennen, Prozesse neu zu gestalten und skalierbare Automatisierungslösungen zu implementieren.

Der erfolgreiche Kandidat wird eng mit Interessengruppen in der Schweiz, Spanien, Großbritannien und Polen zusammenarbeiten und direkt zu strategischen Transformationszielen und operativen Exzellenzinitiativen beitragen.

Dies ist eine hervorragende Gelegenheit für jemanden, der gerne Technologie, Daten und Geschäftsprozessverbesserungen kombiniert, um messbare Geschäftsauswirkungen zu erzielen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Analysieren Sie bestehende Geschäfts- und Datenprozesse und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten zur Automatisierung und Optimierung.

• Design und Implementierung von Zukunftslösungen, die die Effizienz, Skalierbarkeit und Datenqualität verbessern.

• Übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in praktische technische Lösungen.

• Förderung von Transformationsinitiativen im Zusammenhang mit Finanzinstrumentdaten, Referenzdaten, Unternehmensmaßnahmen und strukturierten Produkten.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams und Stakeholdern an mehreren Standorten.

• Bestehende Prozesse herausfordern und proaktiv Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren.

• Unterstützung von Change Management-Aktivitäten, um eine erfolgreiche Einführung neuer Lösungen sicherzustellen.

• Einrichtung von Kontroll- und Überwachungsmechanismen zur Aufrechterhaltung der Datenqualität und operativen Exzellenz.

• Beitrag zu strategischen Initiativen zur Modernisierung und Verbesserung der Datenbetriebsfähigkeiten.

Was du mitbringst

• Starkes betriebswirtschaftliches Wissen über Finanzinstrumentdaten, insbesondere in Bezug auf Kapitalmaßnahmen, Referenzdaten, strukturierte Produkte

• Erfahrung in der Übersetzung von Geschäftsanforderungen in operative und technische Lösungen.

• Starke Erfahrung in Prozessautomatisierung und Transformation.

• Praktische Erfahrung mit Databricks (obligatorisch).

• Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.

• Selbstgesteuerte Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und Initiativen voranzutreiben.

• 3-5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Datentransformation, Prozessverbesserung, Finanzdatenoperationen oder verwandten Bereichen.

• Python, SQL, andere Automatisierungs- oder Programmiersprachen

• Erfahrung mit Business Process Redesign und operativen Transformationsinitiativen

• Englisch (C1-Niveau oder höher)

• Globale Zusammenarbeit

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Kollegen in der Schweiz, Spanien, Großbritannien und Polen in einem wirklich internationalen Umfeld zusammen.

• Zuversichtlich und zugänglich, wenn Sie sowohl mit technischen als auch mit nicht-technischen Stakeholdern zusammenarbeiten.

• Proaktiv und selbstmotiviert.

• Komfortabel, bestehende Prozesse herauszufordern und bessere Alternativen vorzuschlagen.

• Neugierig, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Fragen zu stellen.

• Kann unabhängige Arbeit mit einer starken Zusammenarbeit zwischen Teams in Einklang bringen.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Spécialiste de la transformation des données

Varsovie: jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un spécialiste de la transformation des données pour diriger des initiatives de transformation des processus et d'automatisation au sein des Opérations de données d'information financière. Ce rôle combine une connaissance approfondie des données d'instruments financiers avec de solides capacités techniques pour identifier les inefficacités, remodeler les processus et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'automatisation évolutives.

Le candidat retenu travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les parties prenantes à travers la Suisse, l'Espagne, le Royaume-Uni et la Pologne, contribuant directement aux objectifs de transformation stratégique et aux initiatives d'excellence opérationnelle.

C'est une excellente occasion pour quelqu'un qui aime combiner la technologie, les données et l'amélioration des processus d'affaires pour obtenir un impact opérationnel mesurable.

Ce que vous ferez

• Analyser les processus commerciaux et de données existants et identifier les possibilités d'automatisation et d'optimisation.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions à l'avenir qui améliorent l'efficacité, l'évolutivité et la qualité des données.

• Traduire les exigences commerciales en solutions techniques pratiques.

• Diriger les initiatives de transformation liées aux données sur les instruments financiers, aux données de référence, aux actions organisationnelles et aux produits structurés.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles et des intervenants dans plusieurs endroits.

• Définer les processus existants et identifier proactivement les possibilités d'amélioration.

• Appuyer les activités de gestion du changement pour assurer l'adoption réussie de nouvelles solutions.

• Établir des mécanismes de contrôle et de surveillance pour maintenir la qualité des données et l'excellence opérationnelle.

• Contribuer aux initiatives stratégiques visant à moderniser et à améliorer les capacités d'exploitation des données.

Ce que vous apportez

• Forte connaissance des données relatives aux instruments financiers, à savoir les actions des entreprises, les données de référence, les produits structurés

• Expérience de la traduction des exigences opérationnelles en solutions opérationnelles et techniques.

• Forte expérience d'automatisation des processus et de transformation.

• Expérience pratique avec Databricks (obligatoire).

• Excellentes compétences en gestion des intervenants et en communication.

• Un état d'esprit autonome capable de travailler de façon indépendante et de faire avancer les initiatives.

• 3 à 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en matière de transformation des données, d'amélioration des processus, d'exploitation des données financières ou de domaines connexes.

• Python, SQL, autres langages d'automatisation ou de programmation

• Expérience de la refonte des processus opérationnels et des initiatives de transformation opérationnelle

• Anglais (C1 ou plus)

• Collaboration mondiale

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec des collègues de toute la Suisse, de l'Espagne, du Royaume-Uni et de la Pologne dans un environnement véritablement international.

• Confiance et facilité d'approche lors de la collaboration avec les intervenants techniques et non techniques.

• Proactive et automotivée.

• Des processus modernes et stimulants et de meilleures alternatives.

• Curieux, orienté vers la solution et prêt à poser des questions.

• Capacité d'équilibrer le travail indépendant avec une solide collaboration entre les équipes.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Agnieszka Leputa au +48 538 562 645

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code)

Warsaw, Madrid |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 7548

We’re looking for an AI Solutions Lead - Development Tools (Claude Code) to join our Software Engineering Practice Team.  Your mission: shape how AI transforms the way software gets built at SIX from idea to production code powering the financial markets in Europe and beyond. In this role you define the vision and strategy, design the architecture, evaluate suitable solutions and drive their adoption. You’ll work at the intersection of AI and developer tooling, the internal development platforms and organizational change - putting agentic AI into the hands of product owners, business analysts, architects, testers and developers across the company.

What You Will Do

• Own the AI roadmap for the Software Development Lifecycle — from requirements and design through development and deployment

• Continuously evaluate, benchmark and assess the latest AI tools and platforms

• Prototype and integrate AI-powered workflows when off-the-shelf solutions don't fit, using modern agent frameworks

• Drive enterprise-wide adoption of AI-enabled solutions by designing rollout strategies, running pilots and workshops and tracking measurable adoption outcomes

• as a first project engineer and rollout Claude Code for the Developers

What You Bring

• passion for AI and re-imagining software development

• 5+ years in software engineering and demonstrated experience in Claude Code

• strong understanding of the end-to-end Software Development Lifecycle

• hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools and AI Agents

• ability to drive adoption of new tools and practices across engineering teams, not just make them available

• strong communication and presentation skills, fluent in English

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Cloud Data Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Cloud Data Engineer

Madrid, Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7590

SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization.

What You Will Do

• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.

• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...

• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.

• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams.

What You Bring

• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.

• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).

• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).

• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.

• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.

• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us. Cloud Data Engineer Madrid, Warsaw | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7590 SIX is recruiting a data platform engineer to work on the company wide data platform. In this role, you will be part of a cross-functional team responsible for both designing and implementing a reliable platform for analytics and data science, as well as consulting internal customers who use the platform across the organization. What You Will Do
• Be part of an international team that designs and maintains a mature cloud native data science platform, currently serving more than 14 internal analytics teams and 600+ users.
• Closely collaborate with key stakeholders from business data science teams and IT data engineering teams to enable them on the platform. Identify new requirements, analyze platform suitability, propose best practices and existing solutions through demos...
• Act as a hands-on data engineer to onboard new use cases and optimize existing ones, build production ready ETL pipelines, ML/AI use cases and reporting solutions.
• Implement new infrastructure components with Infrastructure as code (IaC), as well as creating templates to ensure best practices and standardization among analytics teams. What You Bring
• 4+ years of practical experience building production data pipelines, data modeling and BI tools in the cloud.
• Experience with Lakehouse architecture, preferably Databricks, with a strong knowledge of Spark and Open Table formats (Delta and/or Iceberg).
• Proficiency with Python (PySpark) and SQL with a solid understanding of software development and automation concepts like CI/CD to build production data and ML pipelines (DataOps/MLOps).
• Basic knowledge of cloud foundation services (IAM, networking, storage...), cloud costs management (FinOps) as well as tools to manage cloud infrastructure with IaC (Terraform/OpenTofu, Pulumi, bash scripting...) on Microsoft Azure (our primary cloud service provider) and/or Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform.
• Growth mindset and a very proactive attitude for continuous learning and development.
• Good presentation and communication skills. Fluency in written and spoken English. If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko at +34 917095993 . For this vacancy we only accept direct applications. Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background. <div dir="auto" style=" " class="buttontext buttontextdaaac1fecd1a5554 rtltextaligneligible center unmodified backgroundimage backgroundcolore700c1d7b2d8fb3c linkcolorfe3

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Technical Account Manager

Frankfurt |  bis zu 40% Home Office | Reference 7979

Are you passionate about bridging the gap between technology and customer success? Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your technical and data expertise and client-facing skills make a real impact? Then we want to hear from you! We are a collaborative sales-driven team responsible for delivering tailored data services to key clients in Germany, Austria and Eastern Europe. In this role, you will work closely with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.

What You Will Do

• Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for strategic and major clients for all technical coordination and 2nd level support, issue resolution, and rollout of development requests

• Support clients in enhancing existing services

• Trusted consultant and advisor for customers and be the go-to-person for all financial data content questions

• Coordinate and track usage metrics, development requests, and ensure timely communication between internal teams and clients

• Coordinate sub-contractors/partners

• Support upgrades and migrations

What You Bring

• Technical background with solid understanding of IT systems, data structures, interfaces and/or integration processes, ideally within banking or investment platforms

• Min. 3 years’ experience in technical account management or technical project management, preferably in the financial services industry

• Excellent customer orientation and communication skills with the ability to translate technical topics into business language and comprehensive understanding of the German financial market

• Strong organizational / project management skills with experience working in agile development environments is a plus

• Collaborative team player with a commercial mindset and an ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Fluent in German (C2) and English (C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Data Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8198

Do you enjoy working with data, improving reporting processes and contributing to transparency in financial markets? Would you like to support a collaborative team that ensures high-quality reporting services for our customers? Then our REGIS-TR Data Intelligence team would like to meet you. We are a committed team responsible for supporting regulatory reporting under EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR, and FinfraG. Our mission is to improve data quality, strengthen reporting processes and enable our clients to meet their regulatory obligations efficiently. In this position, you will work closely with IT, Operations, Product, other teams to ensure regulatory compliance and support customers and Authorities.

What You Will Do

• Build, maintain, and automate data quality checks and analytical dashboards using Python and SQL.

• Analyze reporting data to identify inconsistencies and improve reporting processes.

• Support operational teams with insights on reconciliation issues, data patterns, and regulatory metrics.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance data quality, documentation, and reporting transparency

What You Bring

• Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience working with data using Python, SQL, PowerBI or similar

• Experience in data quality, or regulatory reporting is an advantage (EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR, FinfraG, MiFIR)

• Ability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Clear and structured communication skills with attention to detail Languages: fluent in English and Spanish (both verbal & writing)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari e appartiene a SIX, il terzo più grande gruppo di scambi in Europa.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Analisi dei dati

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8198

Ti piace lavorare con i dati, migliorare i processi di reporting e contribuire alla trasparenza nei mercati finanziari? Volete supportare un team collaborativo che garantisce servizi di reporting di alta qualità per i nostri clienti? Allora il nostro team REGIS-TR Data Intelligence vorrebbe incontrarti. Siamo un team impegnato responsabile del supporto alla segnalazione di regolamentazione ai sensi di EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR e FinfraG. La nostra missione è migliorare la qualità dei dati, rafforzare i processi di reporting e consentire ai nostri clienti di rispettare in modo efficiente i loro obblighi normativi. In questa posizione, lavorerai a stretto contatto con IT, Operazioni, Prodotto, altri team per garantire la conformità normativa e supportare clienti e autorità.

Cosa farai

• Costruire, mantenere e automatizzare i controlli di qualità dei dati e le dashboard analitiche utilizzando Python e SQL.

• Analizzare i dati di report per identificare le incongruenze e migliorare i processi di report.

• Sostenere i team operativi con approfondimenti su problemi di riconciliazione, modelli di dati e metriche di regolazione.

• Collabora con team interfunzionali per migliorare la qualità dei dati, la documentazione e la trasparenza dei report

Che cosa porta

• Forte capacità analitiche e esperienza pratica lavorando con i dati utilizzando Python, SQL, PowerBI o simili

• L'esperienza nella qualità dei dati, o la segnalazione normativa è un vantaggio (EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR, FinfraG, MiFIR)

• Capacità di lavorare in collaborazione con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici

• Competenze di comunicazione chiare e strutturate con attenzione ai dettagli Lingue: fluente in inglese e spagnolo (sia verbale che scritta)

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Yuliya Stoyko al +34 917095993 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.de:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran und gehört zu SIX, der drittgrößten Börsengruppe in Europa.

Was uns auszeichnet, treibt uns voran: zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, von Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Datenanalyst

Madrid | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8198

Arbeiten Sie gerne mit Daten, verbessern Reportingprozesse und tragen Sie zur Transparenz an den Finanzmärkten bei? Möchten Sie ein kollaboratives Team unterstützen, das unseren Kunden qualitativ hochwertige Reporting-Services sicherstellt? Dann möchte unser REGIS-TR Data Intelligence Team Sie treffen. Wir sind ein engagiertes Team, das für die Unterstützung der regulatorischen Berichterstattung unter EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR und FinfraG verantwortlich ist. Unsere Mission ist es, die Datenqualität zu verbessern, die Berichtsprozesse zu stärken und es unseren Kunden zu ermöglichen, ihre regulatorischen Verpflichtungen effizient zu erfüllen. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie eng mit IT, Operations, Product und anderen Teams zusammen, um die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften sicherzustellen und Kunden und Behörden zu unterstützen.

Was Sie tun werden

• Erstellen, Pflegen und Automatisieren von Datenqualitätsprüfungen und analytischen Dashboards mit Python und SQL.

• Analysieren Sie Berichtsdaten, um Inkonsistenzen zu identifizieren und Berichtsprozesse zu verbessern.

• Unterstützen Sie operative Teams mit Einblicken in Abstimmungsfragen, Datenmuster und regulatorische Metriken.

• Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zur Verbesserung der Datenqualität, Dokumentation und Transparenz der Berichterstattung

Was du mitbringst

• Starke analytische Fähigkeiten und praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Daten mit Python, SQL, PowerBI oder ähnlichem

• Erfahrung in der Datenqualität oder regulatorischen Berichterstattung ist ein Vorteil (EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR, FinfraG, MiFIR)

• Fähigkeit zur Zusammenarbeit mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern

• Klare und strukturierte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit Liebe zum Detail Sprachen: fließend Englisch und Spanisch (sowohl verbal als auch schriftlich)

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Yuliya Stoyko unter +34 917095993 an.

Für diese Vakanz akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Analyste des données

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% Référence 8198

Vous aimez travailler avec les données, améliorer les processus de déclaration et contribuer à la transparence des marchés financiers? Souhaitez-vous soutenir une équipe collaborative qui assure des services de rapport de haute qualité pour nos clients? Ensuite, notre équipe de renseignement de données REGIS-TR aimerait vous rencontrer. Nous sommes une équipe engagée chargée de soutenir les rapports réglementaires sous EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR et FinfraG. Notre mission est d'améliorer la qualité des données, de renforcer les processus de déclaration et de permettre à nos clients de respecter leurs obligations réglementaires de façon efficace. Dans ce poste, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes TI, Opérations, Produit et autres pour assurer la conformité réglementaire et soutenir les clients et les autorités.

Ce que vous ferez

• Construisez, maintenez et automatisez les contrôles de qualité des données et les tableaux de bord analytiques en utilisant Python et SQL.

• Analyser les données de déclaration pour déceler les incohérences et améliorer les processus de déclaration.

• Appuyer les équipes opérationnelles en leur donnant des renseignements sur les questions de rapprochement, les modèles de données et les paramètres réglementaires.

• Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour améliorer la qualité des données, la documentation et la transparence des rapports

Ce que vous apportez

• Fortes compétences analytiques et une expérience pratique de travail avec des données utilisant Python, SQL, PowerBI ou similaire

• L'expérience en matière de qualité des données ou de déclaration réglementaire est un avantage (EMIR, UK EMIR, SFTR, FinfraG, MiFIR)

• Capacité de travailler en collaboration avec des intervenants techniques et non techniques

• Compétences de communication claires et structurées avec attention au détail Langues : parler couramment anglais et espagnol (à la fois verbale et écrite)

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Yuliya Stoyko au +34 917095993 .

Pour cette vacance, nous n'acceptons que les candidatures directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Web Application Manager
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Web Application Manager

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8186

Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business and technology while ensuring the successful operation and evolution of digital platforms?

We are looking for an Application Manager to join our Corporate Websites team in Madrid.

In this role, you will support application management activities, stakeholder engagement, business analysis, requirements management, and agile delivery processes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, developers, and platform teams to ensure our corporate web platforms continue to deliver business value in a reliable and sustainable way.

As part of an international team spanning Spain, Poland, and Switzerland, you will progressively develop deep functional knowledge of our Corporate Websites ecosystem and contribute to the long-term continuity and evolution of business-critical web platforms.

What You Will Do

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand needs, prioritize demand, and ensure delivery of business value.

• Gather, analyze, and manage business and technical requirements, translating them into actionable solutions.

• Support and coordinate application lifecycle activities including releases, changes, prioritization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Collaborate with developers, platform teams, and external partners to deliver high-quality digital solutions.

• Develop functional expertise across the Corporate Websites ecosystem and progressively take on broader responsibilities within key business-critical platforms.

• Support agile delivery processes and contribute to the continuous improvement of corporate web applications.

What You Bring

• Experience in Application Management, Business Analysis, Product Ownership, or similar stakeholder-facing roles.

• Strong ability to translate business needs into structured requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.

• Experience working with enterprise web platforms or CMS solutions, preferably Adobe Experience Manager (AEM).

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Information Security Officer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7942

Information security is a key requirement for the successful and compliant operation of Securities Services. As a Business Information Security Officer (BISO), you act as the main point of contact for information security topics within Securities Services, supporting the appropriate handling of security risks, regulatory obligations, and internal security requirements in line with SIX standards.
In this role, you work closely with business, IT, and security stakeholders to ensure that information security requirements are well understood and applied in a pragmatic and business‑oriented manner. You support initiatives and day‑to‑day activities by providing guidance, facilitating alignment between parties, and contributing to a consistent security approach across the organization.
You will collaborate with central security teams, IT, legal, risk, and compliance functions, and be part of the wider BISO community within SIX.

We are looking forward to hear for you. Please apply with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Act as a key contact and advisor for information security topics within the assigned business area, supporting managers and key stakeholders

• Advise and support projects, applications, and initiatives in implementing information security requirements in line with SIX standards and best practices

• Contribute to the identification, assessment, and handling of information security risks affecting the business area

• Facilitate effective collaboration between business, IT, and security functions to ensure pragmatic and proportionate security solutions

• Support the interpretation and application of regulatory, contractual, and internal security requirements (e.g. data protection, industry standards)

• Contribute to security awareness, reporting, and continuous improvement activities, and actively participate in the SIX BISO community

What You Bring

• 4 years of professional experience in information security, IT risk, IT, or a related field. Relevant training or certification in information security will be a plus

• Good understanding of information security principles, risk management, and control concepts with ability to understand technical security topics and communicate them clearly to non‑technical stakeholders

• Familiarity with regulatory and compliance requirements relevant to financial services is an advantage

• Structured and solution‑oriented working style, with attention to detail

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a pragmatic and service‑oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple topics in parallel and work effectively with a range of stakeholders

• Fluency in English and Spanish (both written and spoken)  German is an advantage but not mandatory

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 7801

At BME Exchange, we are looking for an experienced, customer-orientated business analyst to work on the business rollout of projects and enhancements to the SIX Swiss Exchange and BME Exchange. Are you a flexible team player, passionate about implementing initiatives in an Agile framework environment? Are you motivated to learn about the regulatory framework governing financial market infrastructure and securities trading and analyse how these are affected by new initiatives?

This is your chance to experience the stock exchange from the inside, in a unique, fast paced, and inspiring environment. In this role you will participate in the creation of the common Spanish and Swiss trading platform, contributing to its functional development and market innovation.

Don't hesitate and apply now with your CV in English!

What You Will Do

• Coordinate and ensure changes are rolled out to clients seamlessly

• Write business documents, including interface specifications, and communications to support clients integrating changes into their internal systems

• Coordinate and perform acceptance tests for the Spanish Market and Exchanges platform (SMART), SIX Swiss Exchange and the future common Spanish and Swiss trading platform Equinox

• Analyze and assess business initiatives in Equity, Fixed Interest and Derivatives Trading

• Research for the impact of these changes on SSX and BME Regulatory documents and work with internal teams to ensure Regulators are informed of and approve changes in a timely manner

What You Bring

• Minimum 5 years’ experience as a Business Analyst in financial services

• Ambition to work independently and take responsibility in a small team

• Good communication skills as well as systematic and accurate working methods

• Strong analytical and conceptual reasoning and the ability to impart knowledge

• Very good verbal and written skills in Spanish and English. German is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta  at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Security Platforms Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Security Platforms Engineer

Warsaw |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 7629

Do you enjoy building and operating resilient, automated platforms that sit at the heart of security operations? Are you comfortable owning production systems, improving them through code, and thinking in terms of reliability, failure modes, and scale?

We are looking for a Senior Security Platforms Engineer to strengthen our Cyber Security Engineering team. The role focuses on engineering, automation, and reliability of critical security data platforms, while supporting a broad set of domains such as security logging, detection pipelines, and platform integrations. The role focuses on engineering and automation over manual operations.

Our platforms process and transport security and operational relevant data at scale across multiple regions. This role combines hands‑on platform ownership with SRE principles , strong automation, and close collaboration with security engineering and operations teams.

The role is intended as senior , but we are open to strong mid‑level candidates who demonstrate the right mindset, technical depth, and growth potential.

What You Will Do

• Own and improve security‑critical platforms that ingest, process, and store large‑scale data (e.g. Elastic‑based platforms, messaging pipelines), ensuring reliability, scalability, and integrity of security‑relevant data.

• Drive reliability improvements using SRE principles , reducing operational toil and systematically addressing failure modes, data loss scenarios, and resilience under stress.

• Design and implement automation and infrastructure‑as‑code using Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, enabling reproducible, auditable, and scalable environments.

• Develop and maintain  Python‑based tooling to automate workflows, integrate systems, and eliminate manual operational effort.

• Design, deploy, and operate workloads on container‑based platforms (Kubernetes / OpenShift) as a platform user, while supporting data pipelines (Elastic, logstash, Kafka) and collaborating with platform and security teams globally.

What You Bring

• Core expectations (senior level):

• Strong experience in  platform engineering / SRE / infrastructure roles , with end‑to‑end ownership of production systems .

• Proven expertise in  Terraform, Git‑based CI/CD, and Python , designing and implementing automation in production environments .

• Practical experience working with  Kubernetes platforms as a user , deploying and operating workloads reliably at scale.

• Experience with  data‑intensive or security‑relevant platforms (Elastic Stack, Kafka, log pipelines, Splunk, Opensearch), including performance, scaling, and operational trade‑offs.

• Strong production mindset: experience with  on‑call, incident response, and understanding of system failure modes , combined with a proactive, ownership‑driven approach.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Nous recherchons une personnalité avec une expérience dans l'environnement des services financiers / bourse / trading avec l'automotivation ainsi que la pensée et l'action flexibles (le trading en cours et le quart de soirée). jobs.title: IT Workplace Support Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100% | Reference 7977

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

SIX guida la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Specialista di supporto per il posto di lavoro IT

Zurigo | 100% | Riferimento 7977

Informazioni sul ruolo

Per il nostro team di Workplace IT, stiamo cercando un supporto di livello 2 che garantisce servizi IT stabili, affidabili e centrici per gli utenti presso il nostro sito di Zurigo.

Agisci come punto di contatto chiave per i nostri dipendenti in loco, gestisci casi di supporto complessi e contribuisci al continuo miglioramento e standardizzazione del nostro ambiente di lavoro in stretta collaborazione con team IT centrali e partner esterni.

Cosa farai

• fornire supporto al secondo livello in loco (e il backup per il primo livello quando necessario) per i clienti di Windows 11 e i servizi standard di lavoro

• gestire gli incidenti e le richieste di assistenza tramite ITSM, comprese le attività IMACD e il coordinamento dell'escalation

• installare, sostituire e risolvere i problemi degli utenti finali (laptop, monitor, docking station, periferiche)

• supporto Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD utente e gestione degli accessi

• operare e supportare stampanti, sale riunioni e tecnologia di collaborazione (Teams Rooms, videoconferenza)

• supporto Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) per la registrazione dei dispositivi, controlli di conformità e assegnazioni software

• contribuire alla standardizzazione del posto di lavoro e alla gestione del ciclo di vita (dispositivi, accessori, sale riunioni)

• supporto rollout, piloti e cicli di aggiornamento in collaborazione con i team di ingegneria centrale

• garantire la documentazione accurata di soluzioni, processi e come

• lavorare a stretto contatto con l'ingegneria del terzo livello, i fornitori di servizi e gli stakeholder interni

• sostenere piccoli progetti IT sul posto di lavoro e iniziative di miglioramento continuo

• agire come contropartita affidabile in loco per iniziative e standard centrali

Che cosa porta

• 2–4+ anni di esperienza nel supporto IT in loco o nel service desk IT (Level 1/2) in ambienti aziendali

• forti abilità pratiche in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• esperienza pratica con supporto hardware e rollout strutturati

• comprensione solida di Active Directory / Azure AD e compiti base Intune

• conoscenze di rete di base (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fondamentalis) per la risoluzione dei problemi in loco

• esperienza di lavoro con i processi di ticketing e asset, mentalità orientata SLA

• alto orientamento del servizio, affidabilità, stile di lavoro strutturato e comunicazione chiara

• fluente tedesco (spoken e scritto); buon inglese per la documentazione e l'interazione di supporto

• ITIL Foundation o certificazione comparabile

• esperienza in ambienti di grande impresa

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• Certificazione inglese (ad esempio Cambridge B2 / C1)

Se hai domande, controlla la nostra pagina FAQ

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Spécialiste du soutien en milieu de travail en TI

Zurich 100 % Référence 7977

Sur le rôle

Pour notre équipe informatique sur le lieu de travail, nous recherchons un supporteur sur place de niveau 2 qui assure des services informatiques stables, fiables et centrés sur l'utilisateur sur notre site de Zurich.

• contribuer à la normalisation des lieux de travail et à la gestion du cycle de vie (dispositifs, accessoires, salles de réunion)

• compétences pratiques fortes dans Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (équipes, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• expérience pratique avec support matériel et déploiement structuré

• compréhension solide de Active Directory / Azure AD et des tâches Intune de base

• connaissances de base en réseau (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, fondamentaux VLAN) pour le dépannage sur site

• expérience de travail avec la billetterie et les processus d'actifs, SLA orienté état d'esprit

• orientation de service élevée, fiabilité, style de travail structuré et communication claire

• Allemand couramment (parlé et écrit); bon anglais pour la documentation et l'interaction de soutien

• expérience dans les environnements de grande entreprise

• savoir comment autour de Microsoft Teams Chambres et technologie de salle de réunion

jobs.title: Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.
