Senior Application Engineer

Zurich |  Working from home up to to 40% possible | Referenz 8309

Du arbeitest gerne in einem dynamischen Team und agilen Umfeld und Prozessautomatisierung ist deine Stärke? Dann werde Senior Application Engineer bei Terravis und gestalte aktiv mit, wie wir intelligente, skalierbare Lösungen entwickeln. Als führende digitale Plattform setzt Terravis Massstäbe in der domänenübergreifenden digitalen Abwicklung von Grundstückgeschäften und vernetzt Finanzindustrie, Notariats- und Grundbuchwesen für sichere, effiziente und rechtskonforme Immobilienprozesse. In deiner Rolle als Senior Application Engineer trägst du massgeblich dazu bei, Arbeitsabläufe zu digitalisieren und End-to-End-Prozesse zu optimieren. So hilfst du, den Papieraufwand zu reduzieren, Transaktionen zu beschleunigen und die Zusammenarbeit im Schweizer Immobilien-Ökosystem nachhaltig zu stärken.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Design, develop, and maintain skalierbarer BPMN- und BPEL-basierter Prozessabläufe

• Zusammenarbeit mit Domain Ownern zur Erfassung und Analyse von Geschäftsanforderungen

• Implementierung und Optimierung von Lösungen mit der ActiveVOS Workflow Engine

• Sicherstellung von Leistung, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit in allen entwickelten Lösungen

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Informatikausbildung und 10+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Java-Anwendungen wie z.B.: Java, XML/JAXB, Spring, XQuery

• Erfahrung in der praktischen Anwendung von BPMN und BPEL.

• Expertise in mindestens einer Workflow/Prozess-Engine (z.B. ActiveVOS, Camunda, Flowable)

• Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Deutsch und Englisch; Fähigkeit zur effektiven Kommunikation mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern

• Erfahrung mit der Integration von BPM-Engines in Microservice- oder Unternehmensarchitekturen ist ein Plus

jobs.title: FX Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

FX Operations Specialist

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8275

Are you passionate about continuous improvement and quality in financial environments?

SIX has recently launched an innovative project to transform the way financial entities operate in Forex Markets. Join our team as an Operations and Quality Specialist and help ensure that our products and services meet the highest standards. In this role, you will oversee the daily operations of our Forex Trading and Settlement platforms, ensuring stability and efficiency while driving process and quality improvements.

You will actively participate in testing environments, collaborate with IT and development teams to validate new functionalities, and lead initiatives to optimize workflows and reduce operational risks. If you have experience in financial markets operations, strong analytical skills, and a proactive mindset focused on excellence, this position is for you.

Interested in joining a dynamic team and contributing to the evolution of our platforms?

What You Will Do

• Oversee the daily functioning and monitor operations of both the FX trading and settlement platforms, ensuring stability, efficiency, and accuracy in all processes, and identifying opportunities for process optimization and workflow automation.

• Participate actively in the testing environments of both platforms, collaborating with IT teams to validate new releases, functionalities, and fixes before production deployment.

• Ensure that all operational activities comply with internal procedures and applicable regulations, contributing to the preparation of reports and updates required by supervisory bodies regarding system performance and key operational indicators.

• Support and supervise the onboarding and activity of new clients from an operational standpoint

What You Bring

• At least 2 years of experience in financial markets operations or post-trade environments.

• Experience in a quality assurance or operations role, including testing or UAT (User Acceptance Testing) processes within financial systems is highly valued.

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication skills, and ability to coordinate across multiple teams.

• Proactive attitude, attention to detail, and ability to work in a small, collaborative team.

• Effective oral and written communication skills in business English and Spanish.

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Software Engineer

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8248

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment and build reliable, scalable backend systems? Are you passionate about Java, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures? Then our Backend Engineering Team wants to hear from you.

We are an agile and collaborative team responsible for designing and operating core backend services that power our platform in the Post Trading area of the SIX Swiss Exchange. Our goal is to build & maintain robust, scalable, and maintainable systems that support critical business processes.

In this position, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, and product teams to design, maintain and deliver high-quality backend solutions.

What You Will Do

• Design, develop, and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot

• Build and operate event-driven services using Apache Kafka

• Develop and maintain applications running on Java application servers such as WildFly

• Collaborate with engineers and architects on system design, architecture, and technical improvements

• Ensure reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems

What You Bring

• Very strong experience with Java backend development and modern backend design principles

• Experience with Spring and Spring Boot for building microservices

• Experience with Kafka or other messaging / event-streaming platforms

• Experience with Wildfly/JBOSS is a big plus

• Experience designing RESTful APIs and working with SQL databases

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Yuliya Stoyko  at +34 917095993 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in english.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Madrid |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8178

Join our HR team in Spain as Senior Labor Relations Consultant to cover a 1 year temporary position.

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in HR consulting or personnel management, with at least 3 years in a senior capacity

• Extensive knowledge of Spanish labor laws, regulations, and employment standards

• Proven experience managing union relationships, including collective bargaining and conflict resolution

• Ability to navigate in an international and global matrix organization

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Senior Labor Relations Consultant (Temporary)

Madrid | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8178

Si prospera sulla soluzione di sfide complesse, la costruzione di relazioni forti, e iniziative di guida che veramente importano? Hai una lunga esperienza nella consulenza HR o nella gestione del personale? Stai cercando una nuova sfida professionale e sei interessato al settore finanziario?

Unisciti al nostro team HR in Spagna come Senior Labor Relations Consultant per coprire una posizione temporanea.

Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Applica ora con il tuo CV in inglese.

Cosa farai

• Fornire guida e supporto su tutti gli argomenti operativi delle risorse umane relativi al ciclo di vita dei dipendenti completo; da onboarding a offboarding e tutto il resto, agendo come consulente affidabile per la leadership e il personale sulle relazioni dei dipendenti

• Fornire consulenza legale sugli accordi di lavoro, i conflitti sul posto di lavoro e le questioni disciplinari, e rappresentare la società in procedimenti giudiziari quando necessario

• Monitora gli aggiornamenti delle leggi sul lavoro locali e le normative SIX, assicura le regolazioni tempestive delle politiche HR locali e verifica la conformità con gli ultimi standard

• Agire come uno dei punti di contatto per i rappresentanti sindacali e gestire processi di contrattazione collettiva e negoziare accordi, CBA, risolvere controversie e garantire l'adesione agli accordi dell'Unione

• Costruire e mantenere relazioni efficaci con le unioni per promuovere la comprensione reciproca e l'allineamento con gli obiettivi organizzativi

• Ispezioni e requisiti della maniglia da autorità del lavoro, sicurezza sociale, Agenzia fiscale, e altre autorità

• Leader iniziative HR, tra cui programmi di diversità e inclusione, coinvolgimento dei dipendenti e gestione dei cambiamenti organizzativi, lavorando a stretto contatto con i team HR a livello locale e globale e contribuire a diversi progetti HR

Che cosa porta

• Bachelor o Master in Diritto del Lavoro, Risorse Umane o un campo correlato

• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza nella consulenza HR o nella gestione del personale, con almeno 3 anni di capacità senior

• Ampia conoscenza delle leggi, dei regolamenti e degli standard di lavoro spagnoli

• Provata esperienza di gestione delle relazioni sindacali, tra cui contrattazione collettiva e risoluzione dei conflitti

• Capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione di matrice internazionale e globale

• Forte problem solving e capacità di adattamento, negoziazione e comunicazione

• Fluency in inglese e spagnolo, qualsiasi altra lingua è un plus

BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - drives the transformation of financial markets and belongs to SIX, the third largest exchange group in Europe.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Labor Relations Consultant (Temporary)

Madrid | Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8178

Do you thrive on solving complex challenges, building strong relationships, and driving initiatives that truly matter? Do you have extended experience in HR consulting or personnel management? Are you looking for a new professional challenge and are you interested in financial sector?
Join our HR team in Spain as Senior Labor Relations Consultant to cover a 1 year temporary position.

We are offering a direct contract with us, competitive remuneration (up to 70.000 € gross annual salary depending on candidate’s experience and profile) and a full package of social benefits.

We are looking forward to hear from you. Apply now with your CV in English.

What You Will Do

• Provide guidance and support on all HR operational topics related to the full employee life cycle; from onboarding to offboarding and everything in between, acting as a trusted advisor to leadership and staff on employee relations

• Provide legal advice on employment agreements, workplace conflicts, and disciplinary matters, and represent the company in court proceedings when necessary

• Monitor updates to local labor laws and SIX regulations, ensure timely adjustments to local HR policies, and verify their compliance with the latest standards

• Act as one of the points of contact for union representatives and manage collective bargaining processes and negotiate agreements, CBA, resolve disputes, and ensure adherence to Union agreements

• Build and maintain effective relationships with Unions to promote mutual understanding and alignment with organizational goals

• Handle inspections and requirements from labor authorities, Social Security, Tax Agency, and other authorities

• Lead HR initiatives, including diversity and inclusion programs, employee engagement, and organizational change management, working closely with HR teams at both local and global levels and contribute to different HR projects

What You Bring

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Labor Law, Human Resources or a related field

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in HR consulting or personnel management, with at least 3 years in a senior capacity

• Extensive knowledge of Spanish labor laws, regulations, and employment standards

• Proven experience managing union relationships, including collective bargaining and conflict resolution

• Ability to navigate in an international and global matrix organization

• Strong problem-solving and adaptability, negotiation, and communication skills

• Fluency in English and Spanish, any other language is a plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Sara Perez de la Cuesta at +34 91 709 56 80 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications in English.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Kommen Sie und gestalten Sie mit uns die Zukunft der Finanzen.

Senior Labor Relations Consultant (vorübergehend)

Madrid | Arbeiten von zu Hause bis zu 40% | Referenz 8178

Gedeihen Sie davon, komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen, starke Beziehungen aufzubauen und Initiativen voranzutreiben, die wirklich wichtig sind? Verfügen Sie über umfangreiche Erfahrungen in der Personalberatung oder im Personalmanagement? Sie suchen eine neue berufliche Herausforderung und interessieren sich für die Finanzbranche?

Treten Sie unserem HR-Team in Spanien als Senior Labor Relations Consultant bei, um eine vorübergehende Position abzudecken.

Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit Ihrem Lebenslauf in Englisch.

Was Sie tun werden

• Beratung und Unterstützung bei allen operativen HR-Themen im Zusammenhang mit dem gesamten Lebenszyklus der Mitarbeiter; von Onboarding bis Offboarding und allem dazwischen, als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Führungskräfte und Mitarbeiter in Bezug auf Mitarbeiterbeziehungen

• Rechtsberatung zu Arbeitsverträgen, Arbeitskonflikten und Disziplinarangelegenheiten und Vertretung des Unternehmens bei Bedarf in Gerichtsverfahren

• Überwachen Sie Aktualisierungen der lokalen Arbeitsgesetze und SIX-Vorschriften, stellen Sie rechtzeitige Anpassungen der lokalen Personalrichtlinien sicher und überprüfen Sie deren Einhaltung mit den neuesten Standards

• Als eine der Anlaufstellen für Gewerkschaftsvertreter fungieren und Tarifverhandlungen und Verhandlungsvereinbarungen, KNA verwalten, Streitigkeiten beilegen und die Einhaltung der Unionsvereinbarungen sicherstellen

• Aufbau und Pflege effektiver Beziehungen zu Gewerkschaften zur Förderung des gegenseitigen Verständnisses und der Ausrichtung auf die organisatorischen Ziele

• Handhabung von Inspektionen und Anforderungen von Arbeitsbehörden, Sozialversicherung, Steuerbehörde und anderen Behörden

• Leiten Sie HR-Initiativen, einschließlich Diversity- und Inklusionsprogrammen, Mitarbeiterengagement und organisatorischem Change Management, arbeiten Sie eng mit HR-Teams auf lokaler und globaler Ebene zusammen und tragen Sie zu verschiedenen HR-Projekten bei

Was du mitbringst

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Arbeitsrecht, Personalwesen oder einem verwandten Bereich

• Mindestens 7 Jahre Erfahrung in HR-Beratung oder Personalmanagement, davon mindestens 3 Jahre in leitender Funktion

• Umfangreiche Kenntnisse der spanischen Arbeitsgesetze, Vorschriften und Beschäftigungsstandards

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Umgang mit gewerkschaftlichen Beziehungen, einschließlich Kollektivverhandlungen und Konfliktlösung

• Fähigkeit, in einer internationalen und globalen Matrixorganisation zu navigieren

• Starke Problemlösungs- und Anpassungsfähigkeit, Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

• fließend in Englisch und Spanisch, jede andere Sprache ist ein Plus

Wenn Sie Fragen haben, besuchen Sie unsere FAQ-Seite oder rufen Sie Sara Perez de la Cuesta unter +34 91 709 56 80 an.

Für diese Stelle akzeptieren wir nur Direktbewerbungen in englischer Sprache.

Vielfalt ist uns wichtig. Daher suchen wir nach Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
BME - Bolsas y Mercados Españoles - conduit la transformation des marchés financiers et appartient à SIX, le troisième groupe de change en Europe.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Consultant principal en relations de travail (temporaire)

Madrid: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8178

Réussissez-vous à relever des défis complexes, à établir de solides relations et à diriger des initiatives qui comptent vraiment? Avez-vous une expérience étendue en matière de consultation en RH ou de gestion du personnel? Cherchez-vous un nouveau défi professionnel et êtes-vous intéressé par le secteur financier?

Rejoignez notre équipe RH en Espagne en tant que consultant principal en relations de travail pour couvrir un poste temporaire.

Nous sommes impatients de vous entendre. Postulez maintenant avec votre CV en anglais.

Ce que vous ferez

• Fournir des conseils et du soutien sur tous les sujets opérationnels des RH liés au cycle de vie complet des employés; de l'embarquement à l'éloignement et tout ce qui se passe entre eux, en agissant comme conseiller de confiance auprès du leadership et du personnel sur les relations avec les employés

• Fournir des conseils juridiques sur les accords de travail, les conflits sur le lieu de travail et les questions disciplinaires, et représenter l'entreprise dans les procédures judiciaires si nécessaire

• Surveiller les mises à jour des lois locales du travail et des règlements SIX, veiller à ce que les politiques locales en matière de ressources humaines soient adaptées en temps opportun et vérifier leur conformité aux normes les plus récentes

• Agir comme l'un des points de contact pour les représentants syndicaux et gérer les processus de négociation collective et négocier les ententes, l'ABC, résoudre les différends et assurer le respect des ententes syndicales

• Établir et maintenir des relations efficaces avec les syndicats pour promouvoir la compréhension mutuelle et l'alignement sur les objectifs organisationnels

• Gérer les inspections et les exigences des autorités du travail, de la sécurité sociale, de l'Agence fiscale et d'autres autorités

• Diriger les initiatives de RH, y compris les programmes de diversité et d'inclusion, l'engagement des employés et la gestion du changement organisationnel, travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de RH aux niveaux local et mondial et contribuer à différents projets de RH

Ce que vous apportez

• Licence ou maîtrise en droit du travail, ressources humaines ou domaine connexe

• Minimum de 7 ans d'expérience en conseil en ressources humaines ou en gestion du personnel, avec au moins 3 ans à titre de cadre supérieur

• Connaissance approfondie des lois, règlements et normes du travail espagnols

• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion des relations syndicales, y compris la négociation collective et le règlement des conflits

• Capacité de naviguer dans une organisation matricielle internationale et mondiale

• Compétences solides en résolution de problèmes et en adaptabilité, négociation et communication

• Connaissance de l'anglais et de l'espagnol, toute autre langue est un plus

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Sara Perez de la Cuesta au +34 91 709 56 80 .

Pour cette vacance, nous acceptons uniquement les candidatures directes en anglais.

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: Accounts Receivable Accountant
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Accounts Receivable Accountant

Warsaw |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7913

Are you ready to accelerate your career in a place where expertise meets innovation?

If accounting and financial operations spark your energy, you’ll feel right at home with us.

SIX Global Business Solutions - proudly based in central Warsaw and recognized as one

of Poland’s Best Workplaces  - drives key financial processes for the global SIX organization.

Our Customer Processing Team (Accounts Receivable) manages the full spectrum of AR activities

with accuracy, ownership, and a strong team spirit.

We are currently seeking an Accounts Receivable Accountant who is motivated to develop professionally within accounting and finance and contribute to the seamless and efficient execution of our processes.

What You Will Do:

• Execute daily operational tasks, including applying incoming and outgoing payments, managing customer and subledger accounts, reconciling bank statements, resolving unallocated payments, and processing customer invoices

• Take part in monthly and year-end closing activities, ensuring deadlines are met and data accuracy and quality are maintained

• Provide support to internal departments and external customers by handling inquiries and requests

• Participate in the dunning and collection process

• Contribute to ad-hoc tasks and analyses

• Ensure process documentation is regularly reviewed and updated

What you bring:

• A collaborative mindset combined with analytical skills and a high level of attention to detail

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in Accounts Receivable

• Very good command of English; German will be a great plus

• Solid understanding of financial accounting principles

• Educational background in finance and accounting will be an advantage

• Experience working with SAP FI/SD and very good practical knowledge of MS Office

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Teamhead Customer Service Center
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Teamhead Customer Service Center

Zurich |  (bis zu 40% Home Office möglich) | Referenz 8155

Möchtest du ein 7/24h Customer Service Center mit direkter Führungsverantwortung aktiv mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit deinem Team für einen zuverlässigen, kundenorientierten und effizienten Service sorgen? Als Teamhead Customer Service Center führst du Mitarbeitende personell, fachlich und organisatorisch, stellst gemeinsam mit dem Schichtbetrieb die Einhaltung der Service Levels und Qualitätsstandards sicher und entwickelst Services, Prozesse und Arbeitsabläufe kontinuierlich weiter. Du übernimmst Verantwortung im Tagesgeschäft, im Qualitäts- und Effizienzmanagement sowie in der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Schnittstellen und trägst damit wesentlich zur Stabilität und Weiterentwicklung des Customer Service Centers bei.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Du führst Customer Service Agents und Schichtleiter personell, fachlich, organisatorisch und administrativ und förderst ihre Entwicklung durch Coaching, Monitoring, Zielvereinbarungen und regelmässige Standortbestimmungen.

• Du stellst gemeinsam mit dem Schichtbetrieb die Einhaltung der Qualitätsgrundsätze, Service Levels und operativen Abläufe im 7/24h Customer Service Center sicher.

• Du analysierst Qualitäts-, Effizienz- und Leistungskennzahlen, leitest geeignete Massnahmen ab und unterstützt ein wirkungsvolles Betriebscontrolling sowie Risk Management.

• Du verantwortest Themen rund um Rekrutierung, Einarbeitung, Einsatz-, Schicht- und Ferienplanung in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR, Schichtleitung und internen Schnittstellen.

• Du entwickelst Services und Prozesse konzeptionell weiter, wirkst in Projekten mit und pflegst ein aktives Beziehungsmanagement zu relevanten Anspruchsgruppen.

Das bringst du mit

• Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Fachschule oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung sowie langjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise im Banken-, Karten- oder Zahlungsverkehrsumfeld.

• Du bringst solide Führungserfahrung sowie Praxiserfahrung in einem Call Center, Customer Interaction Center oder Kundendienst mit. Erfahrung im 7/24h-Schichtbetrieb und im Workforce Management ist von Vorteil.

• Du denkst prozessorientiert, handelst verantwortungsbewusst und verfügst über analytisches sowie konzeptionelles Denkvermögen, Veränderungsbereitschaft und Durchsetzungsvermögen.

• Du überzeugst durch hohe Sozialkompetenz, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Belastbarkeit, Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und eine klare Hands-on-Mentalität.

• Du bist sicher im Umgang mit moderner Technik, Telefonie-, Multichannel- und Ticketing-Applikationen, verfügst über sehr gute MS Office-Kenntnisse und kommunizierst verhandlungssicher in Deutsch, Französisch, Englisch und Italienisch.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt  unter der Nummer +41583998670.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Zurigo | (fino al 40% di sede possibile) | Riferimento 8155

Teamhead Customer Service Center

Zurich | (up to 40% home office possible) | Reference 8155

Do you want to actively shape a 7/24h Customer Service Center with direct leadership responsibility and together with your team ensure a reliable, customer-oriented and efficient service? As a Teamhead Customer Service Center, you lead employees in terms of personnel, expertise and organisation, ensure compliance with service levels and quality standards together with shift operations and continuously develop services, processes and workflows. You assume responsibility in day-to-day business, in quality and efficiency management as well as in cooperation with internal interfaces and thus contribute significantly to the stability and further development of the Customer Service Center.

These are your tasks

• You will lead customer service agents and shift managers in terms of personnel, expertise, organisation and administration and promote their development through coaching, monitoring, target agreements and regular location regulations.

• Together with shift operations, you ensure compliance with the quality principles, service levels and operational processes in the 7/24h Customer Service Center.

• You will analyze quality, efficiency and performance indicators, derive suitable measures and support effective operational controlling and risk management.

• You are responsible for topics related to recruitment, training, deployment, shift and holiday planning in close cooperation with HR, shift management and internal interfaces.

• You develop services and processes conceptually, participate in projects and maintain an active relationship management with relevant stakeholders.

You bring that with you

• You have a completed technical school or an equivalent education as well as many years of professional experience, ideally in the banking, card or payment environment.

• You bring solid leadership experience as well as practical experience in a call center, customer interaction center or customer service. Experience in 7/24h shift operation and workforce management is an advantage.

• You think process-oriented, act responsibly and have analytical and conceptual thinking skills, willingness to change and assertiveness.

• You convince with high social skills, strong communication skills, resilience, teamwork, flexibility and a clear hands-on mentality.

• You are confident in dealing with modern technology, telephony, multichannel and ticketing applications, have very good MS Office knowledge and communicate in German, French, English and Italian.

Olten |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Referenz 8082

Möchtest du in einem dynamischen Team im Bereich Post-Trade Education & Client Testing arbeiten? Bist du eine kommunikative Persönlichkeit, welche über ein ausgeprägtes Kundenverständnis verfügt und auch in hektischen Zeiten einen kühlen Kopf behält? Verfügst du über gute Kenntnisse der Börsen- und Wertschriftenwelt? Dann bewirb dich und werde Teil unseres Post-Trade Education & Client Testing Team.

Als Specialist Post-Trade Education & Client Testing unterstützt du unser Team in der Erstellung von E-Learning Kursen sowie bei der Planung und Durchführung von Präsenzkursen. Die Online- und Präsenzkurse richten sich an unsere Kunden und Mitarbeitende und vermitteln Wissen zu mehreren Bereichen der Wertschriftenwelt und zu diversen SIX Applikationen.

Im Client Testing verantwortest du die zentrale Koordination zwischen internen Stakeholdern und unseren Kunden und stellst eine abgestimmte Umsetzung der Testszenarien sicher. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit deinen Teamkollegen gewährleistest du, dass die Anliegen neuer und bestehender Kunden hinsichtlich Testing-Aktivitäten erfasst und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Die Training sowie Client Testing Aktivitäten umfassen diverse Fachbereiche von SIX wie z.B. Settlement, Corporate Action, Tax, Fonds, Clearing u.a.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Erstellung und Durchführung von Ausbildungsinhalten für Mitarbeitende und Kunden (E-Learning und Präsenzkurse) in verschiedenen Post-Trade-Fachbereichen wie Settlement, Corporate Actions, Tax etc. in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen Stakeholdern.

• Durchführung von qualitativ hochstehenden und kundenorientierten Demo Sessions oder Präsentationen von Applikationen und Services, online oder an SIX Standorten, ggf. auch bei Kunden vor Ort

• Interne Schnittstelle für Client Testing Anfragen sowie zentrale Anlaufstelle zur Koordination und Ausführung von reibungslosen Client Testing Aktivitäten mit neuen sowie bestehenden Kunden

• Erstellen und Aktualisieren von Test Scripts für verschiedene Business Fachbereiche wie Corporate Action, Settlement, Clearing u.a.

• Regelmässiger Kundenkontakt, telefonisch wie schriftlich auf Deutsch und Englisch

Das bringst du mit

• Zwingende, mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Wertschriftenabwicklung und im Post-Trading Bereich, idealerweise Custody & Clearing (Settlement, Corporate Action, Clearing etc.), SWIFT Kenntnisse ebenfalls von Vorteil

• Aufgeschlossene und wortgewandte Persönlichkeit, welche gerne ihr Wissen vermittelt und sicher vor Publikum auftreten kann

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kunden sowie ein ausgeprägtes Kundenflair

• Belastbare und teamfähige Persönlichkeit die sich nicht scheut auch eigene Ideen einzubringen

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englisch Kenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Level B2), Französisch und Italienisch sowie jede weitere Sprache ist von Vorteil

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

• Creazione e implementazione di contenuti formativi per i dipendenti e i clienti (e-learning and face-to-face course) in vari settori soggetti post-commerciali come la composizione, azioni aziendali, tassa, ecc. in stretta collaborazione con gli stakeholder interni.
• Condurre sessioni demo di alta qualità e orientate al cliente o presentazioni di applicazioni e servizi, online o in località SIX, eventualmente anche presso i clienti in loco
• Interfaccia interna per le richieste di test dei clienti e punto di contatto centrale per il coordinamento e l'esecuzione di attività di test dei clienti fluidi con clienti nuovi ed esistenti
• Creazione e aggiornamento di script di test per varie aree di business come azione aziendale, regolamento, compensazione ecc.
• Contatto cliente regolare, telefono come scritto in tedesco e inglese Lo porti con te.
• Compulsory, diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel trattamento dei titoli e post-trading, idealmente Custodia & Clearing (Settlement, Corporate Action, Clearing ecc), SWIFT conoscenza anche benefica
• Personalità aperta e eloquente che ama impartire le loro conoscenze e può eseguire in modo sicuro davanti a un pubblico
• Esperienza nell'affrontare clienti esigenti e un tocco di cliente
• Personalità responsabile e di squadra che non ha paura di contribuire alle proprie idee
• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura (livello minimo B2), francese e italiano e qualsiasi altra lingua è un vantaggio Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49. jobs.title: Senior Test Engineer
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Test Engineer

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8146

The name “debiX” speaks for itself, as the combination of “debit” and “experience” reflects our shared ambition: to provide debit cardholders and issuers with a unique experience.

To this ambition, we are developing a future-proof platform that enables new payment functions. This includes Apple and Google Pay, mobile apps, fraud detection and other innovative solutions for the card use of the future in Switzerland. With your expertise, you will make a significant contribution to the development of a modern and stable hub in a growing and dynamic environment. Shape the new debiX platform and help take the SIX Cards, ATM and Twint ecosystem to the next level. You are a member of one of our Scrum teams and work closely with Software and Requirements Engineers and Product Owners. As part of the team, you will take on tasks across the entire software development lifecycle

What You Will Do

• Develop and maintain automated tests for the debiX platform features within an agile Scrum team

• Design and execute UI and API testing strategies to validate system behavior and user journeys

• Expand and improve test automation to increase efficiency and coverage across releases

• Take ownership of test processes and contribute to quality strategy across the whole development lifecycle

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to identify improvements and optimize testing workflows

What You Bring

• 6+ years in software testing with experience in API testing and in UI automation tools.

• Understanding of REST/JSON services and SQL-based data querying

• Experience with testing mobile apps on Android and iOS,

• Familiarity with regulated environments such as banking, payments, or fintech and compliance awareness

• Very good written and spoken German with strong communication skills in cross-functional teams

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Business Analyst with French
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Business Analyst with French

Warsaw |  working from home up to 40% | Reference 8222

Would you like to dive into the fascinating world of equities, corporate action and structured products? As part of a team of specialists, you will analyze and specify requirements for content covering shares and warrants, and ensure accurate handling of corporate actions (e.g., dividends, rights issues) for French Products, Finalim and PGD. You’ll translate all changes sourced from VDF and main primary sources (e.g., Euronext, Euroclear) into clear, testable specifications that drive high quality data for our FR Products and clients.

What You Will Do

• Collaborate closely with the Data Operations team dedicated to French products. Gather all their requirements, evaluate them, prioritize them, and implement appropriate solutions to address them in close collaboration with the CIT teams dedicated to French products.

• Gather, analyze, and document requirements for equities and warrants, with a focus on specific workflows (VDF, Euronext, Euroclear) and stakeholder use cases.

• Own data mapping, validation, and control frameworks for corporate actions and distributions, ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory and tax rules.

• Design and maintain reference linkages across issuers, index components, and economic sector classifications to support downstream analytics and reporting.

• Collaborate with Product Owners, engineering, QA, and operations; author user stories, acceptance criteria, and test cases; support business/UAT and release readiness.

What You Bring

• 2–5 years of business analysis experience in financial information.

• Strong knowledge of equity markets, warrants/structured products, and corporate action lifecycles.

• Understanding of taxation and regulations impacting FR products (PGD and Finalim) and clients.

• Experience with content/data modeling, instrument identifiers (e.g., ISIN), and classification frameworks (e.g., financial sector codes).

• Proficiency with SQL and Excel; ability to translate business needs into clear specifications for analysts, developers, and architects.

• Exposure to agile practices (Jira, confluence), documentation and testing methodologies

• Knowledge of GitLab is appreciated.

• Fluent English (B2/C1) & French (B2) are mandatory. Comfortable communicating in a global, cross functional environment.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Agnieszka Leputa  at .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti luminose e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro della finanza con noi.

Analizzatore di affari

Varsavia | lavorando da casa fino al 40% | Riferimento 8222

Volete immergervi nell'affascinante mondo delle azioni, dell'azione aziendale e dei prodotti strutturati? Nell'ambito di un team di specialisti, sarà possibile analizzare e specificare i requisiti per il contenuto che copre le azioni e i mandati, e garantire una gestione accurata delle azioni aziendali (ad esempio, dividendi, questioni di diritti) per i prodotti francesi, Finalim e PGD. Tradurrete tutte le modifiche provenienti da VDF e principali fonti primarie (ad esempio, Euronext, Euroclear) in specifiche chiare e testabili che guidano dati di alta qualità per i nostri prodotti e clienti FR.

Cosa farai

• Collabora a stretto contatto con il team Data Operations dedicato ai prodotti francesi. Raccogliere tutti i loro requisiti, valutarli, prioritizzarli e implementare soluzioni appropriate per affrontarli in stretta collaborazione con i team CIT dedicati ai prodotti francesi.

• Raccogliere, analizzare e documentare i requisiti per le azioni e i mandati, con un focus sui flussi di lavoro specifici (VDF, Euronext, Euroclear) e sui casi di utilizzo degli stakeholder.

• Pianifica, convalida e quadri di controllo dei propri dati per azioni e distribuzioni societarie, garantendo il rispetto delle norme normative e fiscali pertinenti.

• Progettare e mantenere i collegamenti di riferimento tra emittenti, componenti indici e classificazioni del settore economico per supportare l'analisi a valle e la segnalazione.

• Collabora con i proprietari di prodotti, l'ingegneria, QA e le operazioni; le storie dell'utente dell'autore, i criteri di accettazione e i casi di prova; supporto business/UAT e disponibilità di rilascio.

Che cosa porta

• 2-5 anni di esperienza di analisi aziendale in informazioni finanziarie.

• Forte conoscenza dei mercati azionari, garanzie / prodotti strutturati e vitali d'azione aziendale.

• Comprensione delle imposte e dei regolamenti che incidono sui prodotti FR (PGD e Finalim) e sui clienti.

• Esperienza con la modellazione di contenuti/dati, identificatori di strumenti (ad esempio, ISIN) e framework di classificazione (ad esempio, codici del settore finanziario).

• Competenza con SQL ed Excel; capacità di tradurre le esigenze aziendali in chiare specifiche per analisti, sviluppatori e architetti.

• Esposizione a pratiche agili (Jira, confluenza), documentazione e metodologie di test

• La conoscenza di GitLab è apprezzata.

• L'inglese fluente (B2/C1) e il francese (B2) sono obbligatori. Confortevole comunicare in un ambiente funzionale globale e trasversale.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Agnieszka Leputa .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Analyste des affaires

Varsovie Travailler à partir de la maison jusqu'à 40 % Référence 8222

Aimeriez-vous plonger dans le monde fascinant des actions, de l'action des entreprises et des produits structurés? Dans le cadre d'une équipe de spécialistes, vous analyserez et préciserez les exigences en matière de contenu couvrant les actions et les mandats, et vous assurerez une gestion précise des actions des entreprises (p. ex. dividendes, droits) pour les produits français, Finalim et PGD. Vous allez traduire tous les changements provenant de VDF et des principales sources primaires (par exemple Euronext, Euroclear) en spécifications claires et vérifiables qui conduisent des données de haute qualité pour nos Produits et clients FR.

Ce que vous ferez

• Collaborez étroitement avec l'équipe Data Operations dédiée aux produits français. Rassemblez toutes leurs exigences, évaluez-les, priorisez-les et mettez en œuvre des solutions appropriées pour y répondre en étroite collaboration avec les équipes CIT dédiées aux produits français.

• Recueillir, analyser et documenter les exigences relatives aux actions et aux mandats, en mettant l'accent sur les flux de travail spécifiques (VDF, Euronext, Euroclear) et les cas d'utilisation des parties prenantes.

• Cartographie des données, validation et cadres de contrôle propres aux actions et aux distributions des entreprises, en veillant au respect des règles réglementaires et fiscales pertinentes.

• Concevoir et maintenir des liens de référence entre les émetteurs, les composantes de l'indice et les classifications du secteur économique pour appuyer les analyses et les rapports en aval.

• Collaborer avec les propriétaires de produits, l'ingénierie, l'AQ et les opérations; les récits des utilisateurs auteurs, les critères d'acceptation et les cas d'essai; appuyer les entreprises/ATU et l'état de préparation à la libération.

Ce que vous apportez

• 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en analyse d'affaires en information financière.

• Forte connaissance des marchés boursiers, des mandats/produits structurés et des cycles de vie des entreprises.

• Compréhension de la fiscalité et des règlements ayant une incidence sur les produits FR (PGD et Finalim) et les clients.

• Expérience de la modélisation du contenu et des données, des identifiants d'instruments (p. ex. ISIN) et des cadres de classification (p. ex. codes du secteur financier).

• Compétence avec SQL et Excel; capacité de traduire les besoins des entreprises en spécifications claires pour les analystes, les développeurs et les architectes.

• Exposition aux pratiques agiles (Jira, confluence), documentation et méthodes d'essai

• La connaissance de GitLab est appréciée.

• L'anglais (B2/C1) et le français (B2) sont obligatoires. Communication confortable dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel.

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Raccogliere, convalidare e arricchire le informazioni sulle azioni aziendali in tutto il mondo

• Preparazione degli eventi nel sistema SIX SIS AG (SECOM)

• Controllo e registrazione degli importi in arrivo di titolo e denaro, compresa la riconciliazione (gestione delle differenze)

• Monitorare le scadenze dei clienti, compresa la trasmissione delle istruzioni agli uffici di custodia competenti

• Rispondere alle richieste dei clienti

SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Specialist Corporate Actions (100%)

Olten | up to 40% home office possible | Reference 7963

As a Specialist Corporate Action in the area of "C/A Processing Worldwide", it is important to meet the agreed customer expectations with the best quality. This includes the timely and correct invoicing of distributions from current corporate actions. You are also responsible for the correct and timely processing of the incoming customer instructions for participation in the capital measures.

They independently validate and process the relevant incoming payments (money and/or shares), analyze and resolve possible differences, and clarify various data sources (e.g. companies, registrars, agents, custodians, CSD's, etc.) and/or proactively inform the business partners and/or custodian offices in the event of inconsistencies. They independently manage the corporate action relevant dossiers, monitor the deadlines and are responsible for the professional handling of all transactions. You monitor the customer deadlines and transmit the instructions on time to our custodian offices.

Achieving a high level of customer satisfaction is the highest maxim. An analytical mindset is beneficial for processing transactions.

These are your tasks

• Collect, validate and enrich information on corporate actions worldwide

• Event preparation (billing) in the SIX SIS AG system (SECOM)

• Checking and recording the incoming amounts of title and money including reconciliation (management of differences)

• Monitor the customer deadlines including transmission of instructions to the relevant custodian offices

• Answering customer inquiries

You bring that with you

• Flexible thinking (covering various tasks)

• Good communication skills (verbal & writing)

• Personal responsibility

• Planning skills

• Analytical thinking (possible project participation)

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska on +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.
